She says the villagers wake to the same morning every day. “I remember yesterday, but they don't. You're from outside. Could you help me find out why?”
Follow Qinghe into the village
Examine the formation surrounding the village
Use a probing art to examine Qinghe

The villagers cook and fetch water. Just after Qinghe predicts a spilled basin, it falls. Yet their names appear on graves behind the village. At night they sleepwalk toward the ruined temple together. “It happened last night too,” she whispers.
Ask what the villagers remember
Follow them to the temple at midnight

A gray pearl anchors the formation amid traces of a fox spirit's grief. Following the circuits reveals that someone else's inscriptions collect those emotions. The fox sustains the mist, but may not know where its power goes.
Trace the inscriptions to their maker
Take temporary control of the anchor and trace its core

Qinghe admits she died eighteen years ago and survives only as a remnant. “I've thought of leaving them, but then I see them walk into the mist again.” She will tell you what she knows. You could instead restrain her to examine the formation's traces within her soul.
Protect Qinghe and hear her voluntary testimony
Restrain Qinghe and examine her remnant

Evidence at Fox Hill completes the account: He Xuan killed Feiyue's cubs, blamed the villagers, and used her vengeance to refine the Hundred-Thought Pearl. Feiyue demands an answer. He Xuan instead offers you a share of its power.
Expose He Xuan before Feiyue
Discuss trading the village for the pearl

Houses in the mist overlap the hillside, and villagers' cries reach the formation. Feiyue demands He Xuan's life; he guards the pearl. Qinghe asks you to look at the village first. “Before you decide, remember who's still inside.”
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.star: A black meteor has opened a deep pit in the mining district. The sect's cordon is barely in place, and miners are still searching for people. Black-clad figures guard the descent. A boy catches your sleeve. “Someone below keeps calling me. Covering my ears doesn't stop it.”
Identify yourself and enter the miners' cordon
Descend through a side fissure toward the wreck
Follow the boy toward the source of the call

Gravity shifts through the cavern. Injured miners hang near the ceiling while companions hold ropes, waiting for a change that will let them pull everyone to safety. A miner calls out, “Don't go farther yet! They can't hold on much longer!”
Rescue the miners who can still be treated
Record the gravity shifts and mutations before descending

The seamless metal wreck contains five lights showing signs of killing, wealth, fortune, time, and tasks. Footsteps from rival seekers approach above. You could conceal a fragment or warn them against touching the unknown machinery.
Hide an otherworldly fragment
Warn the approaching parties to stop fighting over it

The boy begins a sentence in an unfamiliar voice, then covers his mouth in fear. The caller is entering, and he can barely distinguish his thoughts from its own. You must sever the connection or accept part of the mark to investigate the process.
Sever the connection and free the boy
Accept a lesser mark to read the information

An earlier failed host guards the core; its clothing and records establish that it is not the boy. It copies your displayed techniques and attempts contact with your soul. An archive seal states an odd rule: hosts see the powers offered, while only those who refuse may read every risk.
Seal off the core and gather verifiable evidence
Seize control of the unclaimed core

The pit's edge begins collapsing, and everyone demands a decision. You must consider the evidence recovered and any remaining marks before destroying the wreck, merging with it, or arranging shared custody. The archive reserved for those who refuse remains sealed.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.bloo: Heavy mountain rain drives you toward an inn's red lantern. The keeper, Hongling, offers a guestbook while holding down its final page. “Write here tonight. Leave the rest until morning.” Several guests sit in the hall without looking up at the opening door.
Register your true name and stay in the hall
Give a false name and watch the ledger
Inspect the inn before sitting down

There are seven guests including you, but eight places at the table. Someone claims each blood night requires one soul before the rest may leave. Accusations begin immediately. No one explains the empty setting.
Protect the guest being accused without cause
Choose a guilty guest and accept sacrifice as the solution

The ledger's last page repeats the same names, with each promised dawn crossed out. One entry even resembles your handwriting. Whatever time it came from, the previous sacrifices clearly failed to restore the inn.
Read the page and compare the repeated entries
Take the ledger to interrupt its accounting

The kitchen worker cannot speak but shows fragments of memory. Old records identify her as the remnant of Hongling's daughter. Hongling arrives and begs you to restore her, while the remnant backs against the wall rather than approach the ritual formation.
Try to restore the remnant and identify what is missing
Confine the remnant in the ritual formation

As an old page opens, the wall's illusion fades to reveal a burial pit below the inn. The eighth place belongs to Hongling, who has charged her own soul debt to the guests. She still asks for a whole soul to settle it. You now know why the balance never clears.
Establish the true debt and ritual rules
Continue preparing a sacrifice under the ledger's terms

The inn cracks between overlapping nights. The seven guests crowd toward the door, but the same rain waits outside. The ledger requires a final act: destroy the contract, pay with your lifespan, or continue the rite. Any shared settlement must include Hongling's eighth place.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.name: Following sword-song into the valley, you find broken steles recording failed cultivation, their names worn away. Su Zhao proposes traveling together. “If we find the sword heart, we'll discuss the division openly.” She notices that these accounts never appeared in the sect's sword histories.
Answer the sword-song and seek an entrance
Study the steles and traces of failed techniques
Travel with Su Zhao and exchange information

The three barriers seize on ambition, fear, and pride. Familiar attacks only strengthen their resistance. Su Zhao steps back and lowers her sword. “Is it waiting for us to change our approach?” You can force through or first understand their intent.
Break through all three barriers by force
Lower your resistance and understand the trials

None of the legible names appears in orthodox sword history. Su Zhao pauses over an account of a defeated cultivator who continued teaching. “Because their path failed, did nothing afterward deserve to be remembered?”
Restore the inscriptions and preserve their lives
Extract the techniques preserved in the steles

Su Zhao admits that her family ordered her to claim the inheritance alone. “I should have told you sooner. That was my fault.” She offers no excuse. “Now that you know, do we continue together or settle it in a fair duel?”
Continue together and agree to share information
Fight Su Zhao in a fair contest first

The spirit opens a register and offers the heart commanding the swords if you add your name. When asked about the bound older intentions, it points to the inscriptions controlling them. Su Zhao waits beside you for the division you discussed to be addressed as well.
Give the swords your name and seek the inheritance
Examine the inscriptions binding the sword intentions

The swords rise, and the spirit waits for your hand. Su Zhao leaves the decision to you. The full heart, a limited intent, and a shared inheritance each carry different costs. If none is acceptable, you may challenge the spirit with your own sword.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.drag: After the sandstorm, enormous dragon bones emerge across the trade road. Travelers help the injured away from the tremors while bone merchants negotiate over the remains. Oasis residents try to stop them. “Don't remove any more! Every piece you take shakes our homes.”
Help the stranded caravan and residents first
Follow the merchants moving the bones
Follow the dragon's cry toward its soul

The oasis stands above the dragon's last heart-vein. Damage to it is reducing the wells. Residents refuse to leave on a warning alone. “We've lived here for generations. If we move, we need somewhere with shelter and water.”
Defend the oasis and try to preserve the settlement
Escort the residents out of danger first

A bone fragment briefly shows an ancient scene, but the buyer asks only whether it can be forged. You establish that the bones retain the dragon's memories. The merchants refuse to stop and instead offer you a share of the profit.
Join the bone trade for a share of the profit
Expose the memories still held in the bones

The fragmented soul names itself Ao Cang and identifies the stolen bones as missing memories. “The vein below still sustains the oasis.” It asks you to recover those memories and hear its history before deciding what to do with the remains.
Recover the fragments and return the memories
Bind the dragon soul for your own use

Sand pours from the skeleton as the heart-vein pulses unevenly below. Merchants urge extraction while the bones loosen; residents fear the next tremor will crush their homes. Repair and mining can no longer remain competing plans without a decision.
Determine what repairing the vein requires
Mark extraction sites and prepare to divide the remains

The earth rises and falls with the heart-vein. Ao Cang waits for its bones, merchants wait to load them, and residents need to know where to spend the night. You must preserve the vein, sell the remains, or lead the people away. Ao Cang's will may also be freed from bodily confinement.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.reve: A boat drifts upstream without a stroke of its oars. The ferryman stops you, warning that this river carries away memories and years as well. A woman begs him to search again for her child, drowned years ago. He does not promise, but asks you, “By boat, or along the bank?”
Board and ask about the reversed current
Help the woman look for traces of her child
Study the memory eddies from shore

The ferryman charges a memory. His boat conceals living names from the water. “If you won't pay, follow the bank to the source. Just don't touch the river.” Asked his own name, he hesitates. So many collected memories have left him unable to recognize his own face.
Pay a memory and travel by boat
Keep your memories and follow the bank

The child's image appears with a patch the woman recognizes. The ferryman warns that this is a past still open to alteration, not a returned child. She grips her sleeve. “Then find out the price. Don't make me look once and go home knowing nothing.”
Investigate the cost of changing the drowning
Urge her to acknowledge that this is still an image of the past

The eddies hold memories paid by travelers. Drawing near reveals pieces of lives. Some owners can still be found; other fragments contain only regret. Returning them may restore what was lost. Keeping them may bring insight and unfamiliar suffering.
Find the owners and return their memories
Keep unclaimed memories for study

At the source, a spirit fish swims through different histories, turning the river with it. Releasing it would let time move forward. Controlling it may change an old event at an additional cost. The images you encountered originate here.
Clear a channel for the fish to leave
Control the fish and establish the cost of alteration

Water surges both ways, blurring the banks. The woman's request, the ferryman's lost identity, and the travelers' memories await resolution. Your decision must rest on their established origins, rather than treating every image as the same past.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.hund: Temporary sick wards stand outside Hundred Herb Valley, with more patients arriving than medicine. The herbs flourish while nearby villagers fall ill. Merchants deny any connection. A physician asks you to investigate first. “Look at the patients, then the soil. We need to know how the two are linked.”
Help the physician in the sick wards
Search the valley for a remedy
Examine soil from the outbreak sites

The available medicine only eases symptoms. Once patients can speak, they describe a free drug trial. The physician wants to distribute the limited supply without charge; merchants propose selling it to fund research. While they wait for your help, poorer patients put away their empty purses.
Distribute medicine freely and collect patient histories
Sell the limited supply to fund research

The herbs that suppress symptoms feed on infected blood. Gatherers ask how many roots to leave. “Taking everything would cover this batch. What about afterward?” You can harvest mature plants alone or take the entire current crop.
Harvest mature herbs and preserve the roots
Take all existing herbs for the immediate need

A hidden agreement details manufacturing disease, raising prices, and testing forbidden medicines on patients. Respected medical cultivators signed alongside merchants. Someone offers the formula for your silence, while the physician waits for the evidence.
Publish the agreement and expose the outbreak's source
Trade silence about the agreement for the formula

The physician prepares a new antidote, but the earlier symptom medicine proves nothing about its safety. A volunteer is needed for testing. Alternatively, burning infected fields within the isolation zone may slow the spread and buy time.
Volunteer to test the medicine through your channels
Burn the infected fields inside the isolation zone

Merchants block the valley entrance to control the antidote's price. The critically ill cannot wait. Your herbs, formula, and evidence determine the available solutions. Burning the entire valley would also endanger those who have not escaped.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.blac: Paper offerings drift along the night road, leading into Black Mountain's market of memories and years. You mean only to pass through until you see your true name under a lantern. The seller says it was consigned already. Check the books, he warns, before pulling off the price tag.
Enter the market and ask the price of redemption
Trace how the name entered the market
Visit the stall selling futures

The broker accepts a cherished memory as a redemption deposit and offers more for additional recollections. The contract warns that a name held here may have its deeds credited elsewhere. Final redemption still requires the market lord's master agreement.
Pay one memory as a redemption deposit
Sell more memories for bargaining tokens

Thousands of name tags hang inside. Speaking some recalls people you had forgotten. Each release condition hangs beneath its tag, while a master register controls them all. The keeper asks whether you seek one contract or the entire ledger.
Check the release terms for the stolen names
Seize the name register

The visitor claims to be you from one possible future, offering victory in exchange for a present relationship. Pressed for certainty, they admit, “I only lived my path. If you choose differently, I don't know what follows.”
Refuse to trade a relationship for a predicted victory
Accept the exchange and its cost to the relationship

The lord produces the first stolen name, on whose agreement the market rests. “Tear it up and the souls can leave. Take my seal and you can rule here.” He pushes over a debt ledger. “A new owner doesn't erase these. Read this page too.”
Examine the master agreement for a way to release the souls
Take the seal and control enforcement

Dawn approaches, and unsettled names fade beneath the lanterns. Redemption, sale, or release must be completed. If the relationship between the two lives has been established, the market may also be forced to recognize two holders of one true name.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.heav: No city appears on the map, yet a gate stands at the road's end. Residents greet you by name and say dinner is getting cold. Beyond lies the life you once imagined. Looking back, you can still see your original road, though it is becoming indistinct.
Enter the life they have prepared for you
Mark the return route at the gate first
Speak with residents who say they have not yet been born

The people have familiar faces, and the meal suits your tastes. Questions about the outside confuse them. “We know the you who has always lived here.” They have memories of their own and cannot replace people lost or waiting outside.
Stay temporarily and experience this life
Explain that your life belongs outside the city

Abandoned possibilities support the walls, while your mark still points home. Other exits lead toward residents' possible futures. Cutting them carelessly could trap those people permanently. The formation's connections need to be understood first.
Trace the walls to the formation's foundation
Investigate whom closing the exits would affect

The residents know they are unrealized possibilities, yet wish to continue. “We feel afraid. We have things we want to do tomorrow.” Their entry into reality would narrow other futures, so any promise must account for more than the people before you.
Promise to try bringing one resident into reality
Decline to promise changes to real destinies

The seventh bell approaches, and the gate can no longer remain partly open. It must connect to reality or return the city to dreams. Those who spoke with you gather to ask whether your earlier answers still hold.
Prepare to open the gate into reality
Prepare to return the city to dreams

The gate flickers as residents argue over which version of you belongs here. Your preserved route and the established crossing conditions are what remain to decide by. The bell will grant no further night of delay.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.nort: Refugees crowd the northern pass while snow beasts surround the roads. Soldiers distribute the last arrows. Some say a scout is missing; others say he returned with an old treaty and was hidden away. Asked what it says, messengers avoid looking at the commander above.
Help with defense and shelter inside the city
Scout the snow beasts and their demands
Trace the scout's last known whereabouts

The wall needs repair and the southern escape road needs scouting, but there are not enough people for both. A soldier asks where you will help. “The wall might let us hold. If we can't, someone must have prepared the way out.”
Concentrate the workers on the wall
Quietly prepare the civilian evacuation route

The snow beast king says a stolen heart-core lies beneath the city. It will hear terms for its return, but will not allow unrestricted inspection of its lines. Negotiation may expose defenses; an ambush may end any chance of further talks.
Negotiate the core's return and the army's withdrawal
Prepare an ambush against the king

The scout's treaty and march records corroborate each other: the commander staged an attack to seize the core. Publishing the evidence may shake morale; hiding it leaves the city acting on a lie. The scout asks you at least to preserve the originals.
Publish the evidence against the commander
Withhold the evidence to preserve immediate morale

The beasts regroup in the snow, and the walls await a signal. Repairs, escape routes, and negotiated terms must now be put to use. You can lead the defense or raise a truce flag to meet the king before the next charge.
Lead the defense and gain time
Open negotiations at the gate

Snow conceals the old battlefield, but the living still need a way forward. Holding, retreating, or making a pact depends on preparations already made. Giving soldiers and civilians the decision also means explaining what they must share.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.esco: Your sect assigns you to escort Danxia and nine medicine chests to an allied sect. Villagers along the route seek help for leaked spiritual poison, but the captain urges the escort onward. A chest knocks and calls a disciple by name. All nine are listed as medicinal cargo.
Guard Carriage
Aid Poisoned Village
Inspect Elder Cargo
The masked attackers strike the chains. “My sister's still awake in that chest,” one calls. “Listen to her before you fight us.”
Hold Formation
Capture Attacker

Villagers collapse from leaked spiritual poison. The accompanying healer prepares temporary treatment from the emergency medicine bag, but Danxia still orders departure. A disciple suggests checking the sealed chests to establish what has been leaking.
Share Antidote
Question Villagers
The people inside have meridians altered into medicine and can still hear you. The formula is evidence and might support a method without living victims.
Copy Pill Formula
Confront Elder
Danxia admits the experiments and offers personal discipleship for silence. The receiving sect waits at the pass knowing what is inside the chests.
Check the delivery papers without handing over the chests yet
Publicize Formula
Both parties demand delivery at the final checkpoint. The people, antidote and evidence you preserved determine who can testify and what happens to the formula.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.blac: The sect sends you to investigate disappearances at Blackstone Mine, but Steward Shi first asks when production can resume. Families refuse to leave the entrance and report singing below level seven each night. When you request the movement ledger, you find fresh scrape marks on its pages.
Audit Ledgers
Descend Seventh Layer
Organize Miners
The books expose forbidden extraction and elders' shares. Before you finish copying someone offers stones. “Some pages might be better left where they are.”
Copy Ledger
Accept Silence Money

The earth spirit has confined living miners in rock chambers with air holes. It answers your calls: “The vein is my blood. How long must I hold after the heart crystal was stolen?” It demands the crystal's return before discussing release and mining limits.
Hear Earth Spirit
Mine Earth Heart
Some miners demand armed resistance while others fear unemployment. “Could we have open accounts and know who takes the money?” one asks.
Arm Miners
Mediate Strike
As the guards arrive the earth heart wakes and passages close. Sealing level seven contains danger while returning below risks time to recover witnesses and accounts.
Seal dangerous side passages while keeping access to observe the core
Bring Truth Up
Guards, miners, elders and spirit face each other above the collapse. Your alliances determine whether quotas, accountability or violence remain possible.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.reco: You are ordered to recover Gu Changfeng and the Chiyang manual, with authority to kill if he resists. On the trail you find that his supposed victims are alive with their cultivation sealed. They can still describe what happened. Another pursuit party approaches, using signals different from those in your orders.
Chase Directly
Visit Hometown
Shadow Other Hunters
Gu avoids lethal strikes and offers the jade slip. “Read it before deciding to arrest me.” It lists disciples rather than the claimed technique.
Wound Defector
Hear Defector
His sister's letters describe experiments burning lifespan. Protecting the family preserves witnesses while confiscating the letters could leave them unable to prove it.
Protect Family
Seize Letters
The second pursuit party destroys evidence under orders to execute surviving subjects. You can expose it or help silence them before Gu reaches the cave.
Expose Kill Order
Join Kill Order
Gu's sister survives in the cave with ruined meridians. He protects her while urging you to read the register as pursuers approach the entrance.
Take Testimony
Hold the siblings under the pursuit order pending a final decision
The besiegers demand surrender while those inside wait for your answer. Evidence, treatment and loyalties determine who can return alive to testify.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.sect: Before the sect tournament ends, a forbidden drug ruins the favorite's meridians. He insists he never chose to take it, while the stewards hurry the next match forward. From the waiting area you hear gamblers changing their bets and someone asking who delivered the injured disciple's last meal.
Enter Tournament
Inspect Wound
Follow Gambler
A steward offers payment for a deliberate loss to advance a chosen disciple. Your schedule has already been worked into somebody else's betting.
Fight Fair
Accept Fixed Match
The drug targets disciples about to expose corruption. Protecting the next target preserves a witness while following the assassin may reveal the buyer.
Save Target
Trace Assassin
The betting book connects merchants, stewards and elders. Keeping it offers blackmail while publication could stop the entire tournament.
Take Blackmail
Expose Betting Ring

A healer identifies a self-destruct seal in one finalist's weapon and a potentially fatal pill in the other, and immediately stops further circulation. The bribed referee still calls for the match while an assassin watches the witness. You must control the ring or halt the event.
Fight Final
Stop Final
The competitors step aside and the ring is cleared while the witness remains guarded. You must present the final evidence and terms for fair matches, concealment, or suspension and reform.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.lin_: You accompany a sect force sent to the Lin clan over concealed mining and withheld tribute. Refugees along the road speak instead of impossible taxes and missing children. An older report dates the envoy's death before his last recorded visit. The commander keeps urging the column onward.
The enforcement elder demands an attack before civilians leave. One last negotiation risks charges of betrayal while offering a way to trace the stolen mining revenue.
The heir accepts open tribute terms while radical elders seek independence through demonic help. Each side wants your support and control of the ancestral hall.

An accompanying steward acting for a demonic cultivator killed the envoy after he found false accounts, then used his seal for an impersonated visit—the source of the posthumous record. The weapon's mark matches secret correspondence showing a deliberate effort to provoke war and conceal the proceeds.
The sect prepares its assault while Lin radicals sacrifice civilians. Exposing the manipulator may be the only way to halt both sides in time.
The ancestral hall burns between armies awaiting orders. Evidence and alliances determine whether suppression, new terms or pursuit of the instigator ends the conflict.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.guar: You are assigned to guard the Nine-Turn Ginseng until it matures in seven days. On the first night an injured fox comes seeking medicine, and someone tampers with the garden defenses. While you inspect the marks, the ginseng quietly asks you not to wake the other guards.
Dress the cub's wounds and stabilize it
Inspect Sabotage
Guard Ginseng
The fox mother waits outside. “Give me my child. I don't want your ginseng.” Returning it offers an ally while keeping it as bait invites an ambush.
Reunite Foxes
Use Fox As Bait

A garden disciple says an elder plans to take the ginseng and blame the guards. He proposes weakening the outer wards at the fifth-day shift change, then stealing it amid the beasts when it matures on the seventh. “Better than keeping it safe for him and taking the blame.”
Arrest Traitor
Join Theft

The Nine-Turn Ginseng asks for one more year before harvest, enough to complete its transformation. You show it your orders. After studying them, it asks whether you will appeal on its behalf. Footsteps approach outside the garden; the people sent to collect it will need an answer too.
Promise One Year
Insist on guarding it until the ordered mature harvest
On the seventh day every faction moves as the beasts turn towards the village and injured guards, forcing a choice over the remaining help.
Divert some guards to protect villagers and the injured
Protect Ginseng

At dawn the fox mother waits with her cub, which still needs medicine. The ginseng offers three side roots for refining if its main root may remain for another year. The sect's agreement and the shares of medicine must be settled using what you have prepared.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.seal: The sect sends you to inspect the seals on a forbidden cave said to hold an ancient demon. As you note the first crack, a voice inside uses an old name for the founder and asks to be heard before you repair it. “Do your records say what happened after he left?”
Repair Seal
Answer Whisper
Read Founder Records
Four seals replay rise, slaughter, fear and division. One was forged later to contain the memory the sect most wants forgotten.
Replace Four Nails
Remove False Nail
Xuanzu says, “I came out of him rather than from outside.” The confined collection of the founder's crimes and desires offers forbidden knowledge for freedom.
Accept Demon Offer
Test Demon Memory

The records locate the founder's benevolent remnant in the main seal and the corrupted half below. Both came from one soul; neither is a living founder in a physical body. Losing either would damage its memories and the defenses sustained through it.
Reveal Founder Split
Hide Founder Split
The elder offers core teachings for silence and orders resealing while the founder's divided halves begin reaching towards each other.
Open a connection between the two remnants
Locate and restrain the corrupted core for destruction
The cave opens before the sect and your preserved memories can be heard. Resealing, destruction, release and reunion await the final decision.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.miss: A seven-person mountain patrol is overdue. Its last message says it has found its own bodies for the third time. Sent to search, you enter hills held in perpetual dusk. Distress signals come from different directions, and the approaching figures all wear the same patrol uniforms.
Follow Signal
Search Survivors
Inspect Repeated Body
The clearing resets with every approach. Rushing reaches a timeline quickly while circling reveals the formation learning your route.
Rush To Signal
Circle Signal
The injured disciple accuses the captain of murder and the captain calls him a spy. Questioning may expose implanted memory while delaying treatment.
Carry Survivor
Question Survivor

The formation has retained bodies from failed branches of the seven disciples' patrol. Their living counterparts are still calling for help. An eighth body wears equipment like yours and carries matching handwriting. Its identity remains uncertain. Burning these remains would weaken the loop, but destroy evidence with it.
Count Eighth Body
Burn the seven branch bodies while preserving the unidentified eighth

The trial lacks a normal exit, but a discarded calibration record gives a shutdown order in handwriting unlike the patrol's. As the branches collapse, you must gather the living or create a breach that can be held temporarily.
Gather the patrol near the exit in the recorded order
Breach the array's center and hold a temporary route
Versions of the patrol gather in the dusk calling identical names. The living people and letters you preserved determine the remaining routes out.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.oute: The sect asks you to investigate seventeen outer disciples who are losing their memories. They show no obvious wounds, but sleepwalk uphill together and increasingly fail to recognize familiar people. Their carers hand you the night records and ask you to find their destination before tonight.
Wake Disciple
Enter Shared Dream
Inspect Guard Array
Their bodies appear sound while the formation drains their souls. Protecting all bodies preserves return; using one disciple as a dream anchor would hurt that person.
Preserve Bodies
Use One As Anchor
The sect repeatedly falls in the shared dream as disciples sacrifice themselves to repair it. Returning the souls weakens defenses while guarding the dream steadies the route.
Guide the seventeen souls towards the return channel
Remain Dream Guard
The elder admits the array drains weaker disciples when stones run short. “That's how we've kept it running.” Exposure unsettles the sect and replacement fuel may mean new victims.
Publish Array Truth
Redirect Array

The seventeen souls fade as an enemy tests the defenses. The elder proposes captive spirit beasts as fuel, leaving another set of victims. You must secure the return channel or preserve full defenses before settling who bears the energy cost.
Secure the return channel for the seventeen souls first
Keep Array Power
Dream and barrier demand their final energy. Your preparation determines whether voluntary sharing across the sect can replace return, a dream keeper or other fuel.
life.immortal_cultivation_mod.quest.thre: You attend the three-sect talks as an envoy seeking resistance to demonic expansion. Public discussion concerns command and supplies; private bargaining concerns sword mines, medicinal valleys and marriage terms. The chair asks you to hear each party before deciding which agreement to take home.
Every concession shifts command. Delegates ask for balance while your own sect hints at the rewards of securing the leadership for itself.
The secret terms reveal all sides exploiting the pact. Publication forces honesty while retaining them lets you play competing offers against one another.
The disciple offered as a marriage guarantee asks whether refusal is allowed. Freeing them weakens the old arrangement while coercion buys stability with one life.
Forged sect techniques mask a demonic fourth party's attack. Before the delegates are all safe someone suggests letting a rival representative die.

Armed disciples guard separate parts of the hall while surviving delegates and the deputies taking over await the final evidence and terms. Any loss must be recorded in the agreement, not concealed by replacing a seat.
The capital's genealogy skips from the eighth prince to the tenth. When you ask about a missing page, the keeper closes the book. An old map also shows the ninth spiritual vein severed, while records for a sealed palace courtyard omit the same year.
Enter the old palace linked to the missing record
Recover the erased genealogy
Investigate the severed ninth vein

The attendant keeps a ninth seat according to the old ceremonial list and brings Ji Wuming from the lower city. The young man shows his dragon mark but asks your purpose first. “No one acknowledged me for years. Do you want me to meet my family, or trade me for something?”
Protect Ji Wuming while he learns his origins
Use his identity to bargain with the royal family

The register says the emperor feared a prophecy, sent the ninth prince to the lower city as Ji Wuming, and erased him from the genealogy. He lived, but this is the last written proof. Publication invites political struggle; destruction makes reclaiming his identity harder.
Publish the ninth prince's name and history
Destroy the last written identity record

The keeper brings Ji Wuming, whose dragon mark awakens the ninth vein. The ritual names him as its sacrificial repair. After reading it, he asks, “They sent me away, and now I must die to mend what they broke?”
Find a way to release the vein from royal ownership
Verify the ritual that would sacrifice Ji Wuming

The coronation begins beneath an eclipse. Princes and rebels await the vein's recognition. Ji Wuming stands before the formation, still demanding to know his part. You can state his known identity or first change the rite that grants one person exclusive control.
Present the ninth prince's claim at the coronation
Change the rite of exclusive ownership

The circling dragon refuses to settle while factions press for a decision. Ji Wuming waits for a clear account. Restoring him, sacrificing him, and installing a puppet are different acts. Letting him leave or distributing the vein among the provinces also carries consequences.
Restore Ji Wuming as the ninth prince and ruler
Ji Wuming begins reform with the hardships he knew in the lower city. The capital gradually prospers, while nobles who lose power count you among the enemies responsible.
Sacrifice Ji Wuming to secure the crown prince's rule
Ji Wuming dies beneath the palace, and the repaired vein secures the crown prince's rule. The court erases him again, this time ending even the ordinary life he had in the lower city.
Install Ji Wuming while ruling behind him
Ji Wuming takes the throne, but you determine the decrees. Power and wealth follow, as princes and great families quietly organize against the person actually ruling them.
Let Ji Wuming leave the succession struggle

The remaining identity papers are burned, and Ji Wuming leaves the capital. He can choose a new destination, but offers no immediate thanks. Both his freedom and the throne abandoned on his behalf need time to consider.
Distribute the vein among the provinces
The vein spreads among the provinces instead of sustaining only royalty. More ordinary people gain spiritual awakening, and local councils take over resource decisions once made without them.

The Cloud Sea Market drops suddenly, toppling shelves along the street. A technician reports the main core missing, with backup stones lasting at most twelve hours. Thousands live on the lower decks, and a mortal city lies beneath. Merchant airships have already begun loading cargo first.
Inspect the backup formation
Arrange evacuation for the lower decks
Trace reports of the core in the black market

As the backup stones drain, the formation master admits the core came from a cloud kun. “Restoring the old circuit is fastest, but it means binding its heart again. A temporary core requires redistributing the city's load.” Workers wait for your decision.
Restore the original circuit first
Rebuild the formation to distribute its load

Lower-deck residents crowd the docks as chests of valuables board the ships. Someone lifts a child and asks how much longer. Cutting away the lower decks would lighten the city, but abandon those still waiting there.
Use the berths to evacuate residents from every district
Jettison the lower decks and those still aboard

The heart belongs to a cloud kun imprisoned for centuries, still able to feel it through the formation. Merchants want it reinstalled; the kun demands its return be discussed first. Whoever binds the heart again can also control the city.
Recover the heart and negotiate its return with the kun
Bind the heart again and take control
The market's shadow covers the roofs below. Backup power permits one last major adjustment: hold the city up long enough to attempt ascent, or steer its descent toward uninhabited ground.
Support the city temporarily for an ascent
Steer toward a controlled landing

In the final hour, technicians await a core connection, residents await ships, and the kun awaits your answer. The redistributed load, evacuated people, and recovered heart determine which final arrangements remain possible.
Bind the kun and raise the city again
The heart reconnects to the old formation, suppressing the kun as the streets rise into the clouds. The guild rewards you, while the captive consciousness remembers who restored its bonds.
Land the market and release the kun
The market settles on open ground, its residents survive, and the kun leaves. Rebuilding starts with roads and homes, giving the workers doing that labor an increasing voice in decisions.
Rebuild on the kun's back with its agreement
The kun agrees to carry the rebuilt settlement after terms are established. The market travels with it, and money alone no longer determines which merchants may remain.
Claim the heart and the market's revenue
Control of the heart concentrates the city's revenue in your hands. Guilds once competing for stalls begin sharing information and planning against their common ruler.
Use a temporary core, complete the rescue, and free the kun

The temporary core holds the city while the last vulnerable evacuees reach safety. The kun regains its freedom, and merchants and workers establish new energy and governance agreements to keep the market running.

Mirror Moon City is checking reflections house by house: those who lost theirs vanished seven days later. On your arrival under the full moon, a city with reversed time appears beneath the lake. The council wants the lake sealed; missing people's families demand a search first.
Follow the missing reflections into the lower city
Protect the surface residents first
Collect both cities' histories

Your counterpart produces a household register. He remembers a different history and finds your surface city unfamiliar. People here have families, homes, and unfinished plans. He will not surrender them simply because someone calls him a reflection.
Recognize their independent lives
Demand control over the mirror city

Sealing the lake may stop reflections arriving, but could trap the missing below. Residents are not fully evacuated, and the council presses for action. Evacuation reduces danger to people while allowing the histories more time to overlap.
Seal the lake passage first
Evacuate the lakeside residents first

The mirror originally split one city into histories struck by disaster and spared from it. Since then, people have been born and formed families in both. Keeping only one history now erases a population, not merely mistaken pages.
Restore and preserve both complete histories
Choose one history as the sole basis

The mirror cannot sustain the increasing overlap. Counterparts begin seeing each other across streets. Stabilizing the boundary may permit coexistence. Breaking it would also remove the force supporting the districts, leaving survivors to find another way to live.
Stabilize the boundary for coexistence
Prepare to shatter the mirror

Two moons shine over the lake, and both populations hold records proving their lives. The histories and people preserved determine which solutions remain possible. Choosing one side cannot make the other's past meaningless.
Preserve the surface city and abandon the mirror city
The missing return to the surface as the mirror city vanishes with its moon. Familiar life resumes, while no one can return to verify the lives lost below.
Let the mirror city replace the surface city
The mirror city alone remains. Familiar faces follow relationships formed by its history. People you recognize may not share your memories, and future dealings require new understanding.
Merge the cities while retaining both populations

The cities merge, retaining both sets of people. Their combined experience strengthens the city while creating disputes over homes, relatives, and agreements. Coexistence requires work beyond the merger itself.
Shatter the mirror, accepting both cities' sinking
The broken mirror releases its support, and both cities sink. Survivors rebuild on remaining high ground, watching for further changes whenever the moon is full.
Stabilize paired cities with safe passage between them
Both histories gain stable city sites, allowing travel without erasing either. Your counterpart agrees to cooperate, beginning with events you both recognize but remember differently.

A wedding invitation names you as a candidate for the Gu Mother's rite. In the swamp, elders explain that a new vessel every twenty years suppresses an ancient plague. Former brides call from behind a curtain. “Before accepting the mark, hear what it leaves behind.”
Enter and hear the former brides
Investigate the Gu Mother and the plague
Find witnesses to the original covenant

Their bodies live, but portions of their awareness are linked; one sometimes finishes another's sentence. Accepting the mark joins that link, while forcibly breaking it damages shared memories. They disagree: some want freedom, others fear what follows for the plague.
Attempt to release the brides' linked souls
Voluntarily accept the bride's mark
The Gu Mother admits absorbing a vessel every twenty years and shows you the plague restrained below. “Kill me, and who takes over?” Inheritance offers control of the network along with its burden.
Identify how to kill the Gu Mother
Qualify to take over the network

The original pact shared plague suppression among the tribes. Powerful clans later substituted outsiders as vessels. Witnesses can attest to the change, but destroying the pact also ends its protection. Restoring it requires those clans to contribute resources.
Restore the shared obligation
Tear up the Gu Mother's covenant

On the wedding night, the vessels' chambers open and the candidates are brought to the formation. Some tribespeople prepare torches to burn the entire nest. You must first rescue those confined or stop a fire that may release the plague.
Protect the bride at the formation first
Stop the burning before the plague escapes

Voices within the Gu Mother plead both to remain and to be freed. Preserving the rite, killing her, or taking control will affect the whole swamp. Ending the sacrifice of brides requires the tribes to bear the responsibility they shifted onto others.
Become the new twenty-year vessel
The mark is completed, making you the new vessel and keeping the plague contained. The former brides' voices draw closer until your own thoughts become difficult to distinguish among them.
Kill the Gu Mother and leave suppression to the tribes
The Gu Mother dies, opening every vessel and freeing the brides. The old barrier fails as well, leaving the newly independent tribes to confront the ancient plague themselves.
Escape the swamp with the bride

You leave the swamp with the bride, who agrees to travel with you and first seeks somewhere safe to sleep. Pursuers remain behind, and news of the failing pact will follow. The past cannot yet be left behind.
Inherit the Gu Mother's body and network

The swarm accepts a new ruler, and the network responds to you. Countless instincts awaken within the same body, competing for control. Your authority must be maintained through that continuing struggle.
Have every tribe support suppression under a new pact

Each tribe supplies a modest share of energy to contain the plague, ending the use of brides as vessels. Disputes still require meetings, but no tribe can shift the entire cost onto an outsider again.

Workshops across the Fire Domain are shutting down, and artisans ask why the heavenly fire is weakening. The main furnace still burns, but its keeper bars access. A chained fire child says it knows the reason. Hearing it, the keeper tightens the chain.
Inspect the public furnaces' fire channels
Loosen the seal and hear the fire child
Hear the master artificer's final forging plan

The main furnace drains the public channels, leaving ordinary workshops cold. Artisans can reconnect their own hearths, though that would end centralized mass production. “Do we keep waiting, or take back enough to work ourselves?” they ask.
Redistribute heat to the public hearths
Concentrate the remaining fuel in the main furnace

The child is a spirit born of the volcano, chained here before it could speak. Returning would let fire flow through the damaged vein again. Keeping it as the furnace heart would preserve production at the cost of its freedom.
Plan the child's return with it
Prepare to bind the child into the furnace heart

The master unfolds plans for a defensive artifact. The final heavenly heart can finish it, leaving no power for the city's hearths. You could instead take the heart for your own treasure, but the city has no replacement source.
Help forge the defensive artifact
Seize the heavenly heart for yourself

The main furnace has strength for one final ignition. Artisans wait outside to learn whether it will finish the great artifact or distribute the embers. Preparations must begin before the old circuit consumes what remains.
Stabilize the furnace for the final forging
Divide the channels to preserve workshop embers

The crystal casing cracks, releasing heat while leaving the heart intact. The child and artisans await the decision: centralized fire, return to the volcano, one great artifact, or safe embers for individual workshops.
Keep the main furnace burning by binding the child
The main furnace burns strongly again, restoring production. The child remains chained in place, sustaining the city's eternal fire through its continuing captivity.
Return the child to the volcano

The child returns through the restored channels, and the damaged vein begins recovering. Mass production stops, requiring new livelihoods, while the spirit is no longer forced to remain beside the furnace.
Finish the defensive artifact with the remaining fire
The defensive artifact is completed with all remaining fire. It can resist future calamities, but the workshops go dark. Residents must rebuild their livelihoods beneath its protection.
Take the heavenly heart away
You leave with the heart while factions struggle over what remains. They disagree on much, but unite in seeking repayment from whoever took their final source of fire.
Distribute embers among ordinary workshops
Safe embers relight the workshops. Artisans form a council for maintenance and distribution. A failing hearth can now be investigated locally instead of waiting solely on the main furnace's orders.

The Thirteenth Island appears between surges of black tide, with ships from centuries apart along its shore. A cartographer asks for help finding his daughter, showing a chart repeatedly revised for the return route. A coral clock turns above the island, changing the waves with each chime.
Follow the chart onto the island
Rescue the ships caught in the tide first
Inspect the tide clock at the island's center

The inhabitants come from different eras and cannot agree on the current year. Temporary anchors can slow the drift, while temporal relics help sustain the island. Someone begs you not to strip it like earlier treasure seekers.
Set temporary anchors to steady the island
Seize temporal relics from the island

Captains give their ships' names, departure years, and home ports, each asking to go first. The tidal window is short. You can guide all at once or concentrate on one; the others will not find a route simply because you turn away.
Guide all the lost ships
Prioritize one ship

The mechanism currently restores one era by displacing others. Old calibration grooves suggest sequential returns may be possible. Another circuit borrows tidal time for cultivation, charging the cost to future lost travelers.
Calibrate separate time slots for every return route
Use the black tide's time for cultivation
As the tide retreats, the island sinks. Residents gather at the anchors while ships await their return currents. Delay will undo both preparations; one must be stabilized now.
Support the island while preparing a present-day anchor
Open the currents leading to the different eras

The clock sounds across different eras. Bodies have remained at the age of disappearance while memories accumulated, explaining the daughter's long experience to the cartographer. With their return dates in hand, people wait to learn whether they will enter today, remain, or return to their own time.
Return the recently missing to the present
The cartographer is reunited with his daughter as the recently missing return. Ancient travelers vanish with the displaced currents. This return preserves the present.
Anchor the island permanently in the present
The island stops drifting, and survivors from different eras build a settlement. Its position can finally be charted, while its inhabitants must work out how to live with their differing customs.
Retain the circuit for borrowed cultivation time
One outside year gives you decades of cultivation within the tide. The circuit remains available, but each use makes an unknown traveler disappear. Someone always pays for the extra years.
Destroy the clock and let the island sink
The clock breaks and the island sinks into Guixu. Its inhabitants are cast into unknown histories, leaving those ashore unable to confirm where they went.
Return every ship to its own era in sequence

The repaired clock opens the currents in sequence, returning each person to the moment after disappearance without sacrificing an era. The cartographer's daughter comes home carrying centuries of memories.

A classroom at Futian Academy has seven desks but only six names on its register. Students insist the empty seat has always been there. While you read, a plea appears in the margin, moving to the next page as you turn it.
Inspect the seventh desk
Answer the plea in the margin
Enter the restricted archive to examine the fate register

Pei Zhao's name is carved beneath the desk. A note says he was erased after a prophecy named him a threat. Restoring him would change altered relationships; leaving the seat empty preserves the other students' history without him.
Restore Pei Zhao's identity record
Leave the seat unnamed for now

Pei Zhao explains from the margin that the seventh seat was his before the register trapped him in blank text. He wants to return, knowing others have lived years without him. “Don't promise nothing will change. Tell me who would be affected.”
Help him find a way back into reality
Take his erased destiny for yourself

The academy creates prodigies by shifting disasters between students and concentrating opportunities. Disabling the register ends that prediction system. Continuing to write means assuming authority over who pays its costs.
Mark the fate-altering pages for deactivation
Write a new fate for yourself

When the headmaster opens Pei Zhao's page, records of current students' achievements fade. Pei Zhao wants his life back; the students resist losing their efforts. You must restore the old history or preserve the present order while seeking another solution.
Prepare to restore Pei Zhao's original life
Stabilize the current students' history first

Ink spreads across every register, making the seventh seat's status impossible to defer. You must restore, preserve, or abolish the register. If an independent history has been established, Pei Zhao may return without overwriting others.
Restore the seventh seat and Pei Zhao's original history
Pei Zhao returns to his desk, exposing the academy's manipulation. Restoring the earlier history changes achievements and relationships that those involved must now confront.
Preserve the present and leave the seat empty
The current students retain their lives, while Pei Zhao remains in the margins. You gain access to the register, but the seventh desk stays empty and his writing still appears beside the text.
Burn the register and end its allocation of fate
The assigned futures burn with the register. The academy loses its reliable method of creating prodigies. Students must work for success without taking another person's life to obtain it.
Take the register and rewrite with it yourself
The register gives you limited power to alter future events. Each change still transfers misfortune to a stranger. The responsibility once held by the academy is now yours.
Give Pei Zhao an independent life that overwrites no one
Pei Zhao gains a stable independent history, leaving the page without taking the current students' lives. Carrying his memories of erasure, he can finally choose a destination as your companion.

Pilgrims gather at Formless Temple seeking relief. One says his pain is gone, along with concern for his children or any wish to visit them. As the greeter invites you inside, he holds your sleeve. “I know something is wrong. I just hardly care anymore.”
Hear the pilgrims' accounts
Inspect the store of surrendered emotions
Examine the seventh statue appearing at night

Love and the will to live have been taken as attachments, leaving some unwilling even to rise. Restoration brings pain and purpose back together. Erasing what remains preserves calm at the cost of the wish to choose anything.
Return identifiable emotions to their owners
Erase the final emotional remnants

The stored emotions seek an exit, though some owners died long ago. Identifiable feelings can be returned; those without living owners need another placement. Taking them into yourself allows examination while admitting unfamiliar thoughts.
Identify owners and open return channels
Temporarily contain some emotions to examine the store

The statue's voices come from surrendered emotions, still recalling homes and experiences. Some ask you to find pilgrims; others have nowhere to return and beg not to be erased. Their wishes need to be heard before you can distinguish what is possible.
Hear the voices and identify their origins
Volunteer to contain the statue's emotions

The abbot begins merging with the statue to create a desireless Buddha before the conflict tears the temple apart. The pilgrims' feelings remain tied to the formation. Stopping or assisting affects them, requiring control of the situation before a final decision.
Interrupt the desireless ascension
Stabilize the merger and examine its full cost

Different faces appear across the statue as pilgrims await their feelings. Unclaimed emotions need placement rather than being forced onto strangers. You can return, contain, or destroy them, or transform the extraction method into a mirror for self-understanding.
Complete the desireless Buddha's merger

The abbot gains great power and almost no emotion. Arguments cease, while longtime residents become harder to distinguish in temperament. Everyone is calm, and former concerns gradually go unmentioned.
Return identifiable emotions and separately place the unclaimed
Love and pain return together. Pilgrims cry, laugh, and describe their own feelings again. Emotions without living owners receive separate care, and the temple holds many different voices once more.
Contain the collected desires yourself
The statue's insight enters your mind along with its accumulated personalities. You can still consider major decisions, but your own desires are no longer the only ones answering.
Destroy the statue and stored emotions
The statue and emotions are destroyed, stopping the temple from tearing apart. Thousands lose any chance of recovering what was removed and must live with that absence.
Make the statue a mirror that removes no feelings
The statue becomes a mirror that reveals feelings without taking them. The temple begins helping visitors recognize and face inner demons while retaining their individual selves.

An unexplained record advances your death by a year and leads you to the Nine Nether Ferry. The ferryman calls passengers aboard, including the still-living Shen Nian, while a nameless soul receives no answer. You show the false date. He asks, “Who sold us those years?”
Check your entry in the ledger
Ask why Shen Nian is being taken aboard
Trace the lifespan trade
Someone paid to change the date, yet the ferryman asks you to sign it. Signing grants recognition from the underworld while accepting its accounting. Erasing the false date challenges its enforcers.
Sign beside the date and accept registration
Erase the altered death date

Shen Nian's remaining years were sold, and the ferry ledger treats that sale as her death. The ferryman offers release for an equal lifespan payment. She asks, “Why charge someone again when the stolen years can still be found?”
Seek a way to return Shen Nian to the living world
Have her board according to the ledger

The vault divides poor people's years into tradable shares, each traceable to an owner. Returning them corrects many scheduled deaths. Keeping them brings lifespan or wealth along with responsibility for the years taken.
Identify owners and prepare to return the stolen years
Keep the years for yourself

The bell sounds and the boat leaves shore, urging listed souls across. You can force it to turn or temporarily take the oar to halt it. Becoming the permanent ferryman would make every future passenger your responsibility.
Turn the boat before it crosses
Take the oar temporarily and stop at the boundary

The boat waits at the final channel while Shen Nian looks toward shore. The ferryman demands that names, stolen years, and evidence be reconciled before release, delivery, or prosecution. Correcting the fraud must not damage legitimate lifespans.
Redeem Shen Nian with your own years
Shen Nian returns to the living world, and your pledged years are truly lost. She remembers who brought the boat back, making your connection more than a passing encounter.
Send Shen Nian across and accept underworld authority
Shen Nian crosses, and the underworld grants your authority. Her family continues investigating why a living person was recorded as dead through a transaction.
Defeat the lifespan traders and return stolen years
The traders are defeated, the years restored, and many premature deaths canceled. Your false date is erased too, allowing life to continue under its actual limits.
Become the ferryman permanently
You accept the oar permanently, and the ferry follows your orders. Authority over souls comes with responsibility for every crossing, not only passengers you prefer.
Correct every falsified death date precisely
Every fraudulent date is corrected without disturbing natural lifespans. The shores establish a lasting safe route and verifiable records for future accounting.

Expeditions leave Boundary City westward and return through its eastern gate. Traveling partway with one, you see the same scratches recur on milestones while the walls pulse like breathing. The gatekeeper closes the passage. “Investigate first. More expeditions will only produce the same report.”
Trace the entire looping road
Compare the repeated expeditions
Enter the breathing boundary wall

The road loop forms part of the prison. Opening it connects another city and weakens the boundary. Reinforcement keeps the creature confined but also prevents residents leaving. Both approaches alter the same lock.
Reinforce the looping road
Break the loop and connect the other city

People recognize counterparts across the fissure and discover that injuries pass between them. Some seek shared memories; others propose sacrificing the other city. You point out that without severing the injury link, sacrificing one side may harm everyone.
Exchange memories and records between the expeditions
Separate the teams and examine the conditions for sacrificing one city

The world-devourer offers passage between realms in exchange for remote lands to consume. An old plan could move its prison into an empty realm and free the city from guard duty, but the boundary calculations are incomplete. Repairing the existing prison is safer and keeps the roads closed.
Repair the existing prison formation
Negotiate the devourer's feeding terms

As the cities overlap, circuits within the wall appear, revealing how injuries pass between counterparts. Separating them permits one city to be handled independently. Saving both requires re-anchoring the prison or completing its transfer to an empty realm.
Anchor both cities to maintain the prison
Attempt to detach the cities from the prison

Unfamiliar stars appear beyond the wall, drawing both populations to the fissure. Remaining seal strength, counterpart links, and relocation calculations determine the possible exits. Neither city is an empty shell to disregard.
Strengthen the seal and keep the city guarding it
The strengthened seal puts the devourer back to sleep. The city is protected from outside intrusion, but residents remain within looping roads, leaving travel beyond for the future.
Open the boundary and fight the devourer for passage
The devourer attempts escape through the opened gate, and you defeat it. A passable route beyond the boundary reveals a new world map and paths toward higher cultivation.
Sever the injury link and sacrifice one city to free the other
The injury circuit is severed before one city fills the gate, freeing the other. Survivors count their lost counterparts individually. No one records the sacrificed city as uninhabited.
Accept the devourer's recurring tribute pact
The power lets you cross space instantly, while the devourer collects regular tribute. Energy, buildings, or remote land may be demanded next. Reluctance to pay does not end the pact.
Move the devourer to an empty realm and unite the cities for travel

The devourer is sealed separately in an empty realm, and the cities unite as a moving fortress. Residents travel with their homes and records, no longer sustaining someone else's prison through their daily lives.

life.immortal_cultivation_mod.map.travel: The injured cultivator blames a beast for the collapse while the caravan leader suspects a scout. Both want you to believe them and a route is still needed.
Help the wounded cultivator
Treating the stranger gains a grateful guide at the cost of time and stamina.
Search the surrounding slopes
Following the tracks reveals hidden supplies and a route around the collapse.
Continue without stopping
The caravan leaves the dispute behind and continues safely.
Seize the cultivator's storage bag
You take the bag and abandon the injured cultivator, gaining wealth and a greater local wanted status.
The bandits push captives into the road. “Pay first if you want your people to pass.”
Break through by force
You break the ambush and recover part of the stolen property before leaving the road.
Pay the demanded toll
Paying the ransom gets the group through safely.
Abandon the road and flee
You escape through rough country with shaken composure and your life intact.
Negotiate for the captives
Negotiation divides the bandits and opens the route without a full battle.
The spiritual storm scrambles weather, Qi and direction as the group stops and someone calls for shelter.
Shelter until it passes
Sheltering safely delays the journey until the next annual phase.
Force a path through
You cross with injuries and hard-earned combat experience.
Study the storm's circulation
The storm strains your mind while revealing an unusual pattern of Qi circulation.
Harvest concentrated Qi
You collect the condensed Qi at risk and continue with increased cultivation.
A broken seal exposes the illegal cargo. The manager tries to close the box. “Could we keep this quiet until the journey's over?”
Report the cargo
The authorities seize the cargo after your report and pay the reward.
Ignore it
You keep quiet as the cargo is concealed again and the journey continues.
Join the transaction
You receive a share of the illicit trade and become complicit in it.
Confiscate it yourself
Seizing the cargo by force gains property and local enemies.
The huge flying beast follows until it folds its wings into a dive and the group scatters between confrontation and cloud cover.
Repel the beast
You repel the beast after a dangerous aerial fight.
Evade through cloud cover
The group escapes through clouds and remains tense long after losing sight of the beast.
Attempt to tame it
Enduring its attacks lets you establish a bond and gain a new spiritual mount.
Follow it off route
Following it off route reveals a lead concerning the hidden Guixu islands.
A failed spatial anchor opens the exit at the wrong coordinates and the passage distorts as you choose stabilization, endurance or an abort.
Stabilize the formation
Repairing the anchor brings a safe arrival and new spatial understanding.
Endure the distortion
You endure the distorted passage and reach the destination with injuries.
Abort the teleport
The formation shuts down safely before worsening and the journey is delayed.
Observe the broken coordinates
Observing the faulty coordinates before arrival yields insight for your cultivation.

guidance.immortal_cultivation_mod.chapte: Chapter 0 · Mortal Awakening
Before sensing Qi, a mortal must first awaken the body's potential with an Enlightenment Pill.
Find an Enlightenment Pill
Follow the cave bearing %s for %s blocks to X: %s, Z: %s. Search its chest for the pill.
The guidance is searching the world for the nearest ancient cave.
Return to the Overworld; the cave guidance cannot cross dimensions.
Chapter 1 · First Steps
Heaven and earth hold spirit. First know yourself, then awaken the sense of Qi.
Examine your cultivation state
Press [%s] to open cultivation stats. The highlighted fields show realm, spirit root, vitality, and lifespan.
Enter Qi Refining
Consume an Enlightenment Pill and complete awakening to sense the world's Qi.
Chapter 2 · Drawing Qi Within
Draw worldly Qi through the meridians and settle it within the dantian.
Absorb Qi while meditating
Press [%s] and genuinely absorb 100 Qi. Denser-Qi locations recover it faster.
Activate a cultivation method

Learn and activate the provided Basic Breathing Method. Methods affect cultivation speed, Qi recovery, affinity, and breakthroughs. Spell and method puzzle tiers depend on the major realm gap. Same realm: Foundation; +1 realm: Golden Core; +2: Nascent Soul. Lower-realm content uses Qi Refining difficulty. Basic Breathing and Clear Heart are starter methods. Their puzzles always use a simple 5×5 Qi Refining board with extra spare moves; realm gaps and low talent do not add advanced mechanisms.
Chapter 3 · First Techniques
Spell and method puzzles scale with major realm difference. After learning a spell, equip it, select it, and cast it.
Learn your first spell

Study the provided Wind Blade scroll through its Lingqi Trajectory puzzle. Spell and method puzzle tiers depend on the major realm gap. Same realm: Foundation; +1 realm: Golden Core; +2: Nascent Soul. Lower-realm content uses Qi Refining difficulty.
Equip the spell to the wheel
Press [%s], then add a learned spell to the spell wheel.
Cast the equipped spell

Use [%s] for the spell wheel and [%s] to cast the selected spell. A successful innate ability activation briefly writes its Chinese name across the view in enormous brush calligraphy, with glowing edges and flying ink. The caster and all players within 32 blocks in the same dimension see the burst. The strokes disappear within about a second while combat continues. Toggling an ability off or inspecting it produces no title. The unfinished curse announces its actual rescue, not its status check.
Release a spell at 150%% charge
Hold [%s], then release after charge reaches at least 150%%.
Build spell proficiency
Practice advances real proficiency: Beginner → Minor Success → Major Success → Perfection → Peak.
Chapter 4 · Spiritual Sense
Eyes perceive form; spiritual sense perceives life, Qi, formations, and intent.
Release spiritual sense
Press [%s] to toggle spiritual sense and let its perception sphere expand.
Sense an animal or monster through a wall

1. Find a living sheep, cow, or ordinary monster.
2. Put one layer of ordinary solid blocks between you and it, blocking direct sight. Merely turning your back does not count.
3. Press [%s] to enable Spiritual Sense. Stand close to the wall and let its sensing range expand to the creature.
Completion: sense that living creature through the wall. The objective completes automatically; no attack is needed.
No detection? Move closer, try an ordinary animal, or reduce the obstruction. Plants, dropped items, and Qi traces do not count.
Chapter 5 · Cultivator Combat
Cultivator combat alternates weapons, movement, spells, defense, and Qi control.
Land a weapon attack
Press [%s] for combat mode, then land a real weapon hit. A cultivator's Interact → Spar option provides safe practice.
Use a weapon technique
Charge and land a heavy attack with any weapon, including vanilla weapons, or use a weapon-specific technique.
Cast during combat
Create an opening and press [%s] to cast a learned technique successfully.
Use a charged combat spell
Hold [%s] and release a technique at 150%% charge while fighting.
Keep a safe Qi reserve
Cast successfully without allowing Qi to fall below 20%%.
Recognize an enemy attack
Block or survive a projectile/telegraphed technique instead of ignoring it.
Chapter 6 · Storage and Equipment
Equipment belongs in its proper slot; storage pouches and protective accessories each have their own controls.
Equip a cultivation item
Place suitable armor or clothing into its real equipment slot.
Open a Qi pouch
Use a Qi pouch to enter its top-down internal-space interface.
Place a block inside
Drag a valid block into the real buildable internal space.
Remove a placed block
Double-click a placed block to return it to your inventory.
Chapter 7 · Spiritual Veins
Worldly Qi gathers into underground currents whose centers empower cultivation.
Detect a spiritual vein
Use spiritual sense until an actual vein signature enters perception.
Reach the vein center
Follow the sensed Qi flow and stand within four blocks of its center.
Chapter 8 · Artifact Forging
Complete a real forging process: recipe, materials, flame, temperature, melting, and the finished item. Higher-grade materials require stronger flames.
Open a forge ding
Interact with a placed ding to open its forging interface.
Add the required materials
Fill the highlighted material slots with the recipe's real ingredients.
Insert the recipe jade slip
Place the matching recipe slip into the highlighted recipe slot.
Raise and control temperature
Begin forging and pulse the fire toward the displayed target range.
Maintain the melt
Keep the forge active while its real melting progress advances.
Complete the forged item
Finish a successful forging cycle and produce its actual output.
Chapter 9 · Recipe Jade Slips
Complex recipes are carried by jade slips and used by their proper system.
Use a recipe jade slip
Learn a spell scroll, or use a forging jade slip in a real recipe. Spell puzzles scale with realm gap; forging recipes do not use this rule.
Chapter 10 · Formations
Craft the Magic Ritual Guide from a Book and Low-Grade Spirit Stone. Formation cultivators carry the Ritual Dagger needed to build formations.
Place a blank Magic Center
Shift-right-click with a Ritual Dagger, choose a radius, and place the center beneath you. It records you as its owner.
Complete a valid circle pattern
Right-click with the Ritual Dagger to draw the circles required by a diagram in the Magic Ritual Guide.
Transform the center
Strike the completed center with the Ritual Dagger to transform it into the matched formation.
Chapter 11 · Formation Flags
Flags modify an existing formation; their tooltips retain exact effects.
Open the octagon flag tab
Open a center, then select its highlighted octagon tab.
Install a formation flag
Insert a real formation flag into one highlighted octagon slot.
Chapter 12 · The Cultivation World
Cultivators possess identity, realm, relationships, inventory, and goals.
Speak with a cultivator
Interact with a real cultivator NPC and choose a dialogue option.
Complete an NPC trade
Inspect the NPC's inventory and complete one valid exchange.
Accept an NPC task
Accept one actual quest from a cultivator.
Chapter 13 · Breakthrough
A breakthrough opens only after meeting the current stage requirements. Some major realms have separate trials, with lasting consequences for failure.
Reach the current realm limit
Fill cultivation progress and Qi; required pills and method limits still apply.
Begin a breakthrough
Open cultivation stats and use the highlighted breakthrough control.
Succeed in the breakthrough
Complete the actual breakthrough or Golden Core trial successfully.
Chapter 14 · Foundation Establishment
Foundation Establishment brings sustained techniques, mobility, defense, and outward Qi.
Reach Foundation Establishment
Advance to Foundation Establishment through the real breakthrough path.
Release external Qi through a weapon
Use [%s] to enable and release real outward weapon Qi.
Sustain controlled combat for 60 seconds
Remain in combat for 60 seconds without letting Qi fall below 20%%.
Chapter 15 · Flight
Golden Core unlocks creative-style flight. Double-tap Jump to take off; Jump rises and Sneak descends.
Take flight
Enable Golden Core flight in settings, then double-tap Jump. For sword flight, release and control a sword, then use Toggle Sword Flight (default N). Same movement controls; no vehicle mount.
Remain airborne for 10 seconds

Stay airborne for 10 seconds. Normal speed caps: Golden Core x5, Nascent Soul x10, Soul Transformation and above x20. Sword flight multiplies selected speed by 1.5 after the cap (max x7.5/x15/x30). Enable flight mouse-wheel control in settings to adjust speed.
Recall a flying weapon
Recall a flying sword with the recall control. Automatic recall is on by default and can be disabled in cultivation settings. Free inventory space if needed.
Chapter 16 · Golden Core
Qi condenses into a core, improving spiritual sense and unlocking Golden Core systems. Failed tribulation can leave a cultivator at Half-step Golden Core.
Form a Golden Core
Complete the Golden Core challenge and survive its tribulation.
Use strengthened spiritual sense
Release spiritual sense after reaching Golden Core and observe its clearer reach.
Enter Golden Core inner space
Use the Golden Core control in cultivation stats to enter the real pocket dimension.
Side Path · Corpse Arts
A concealed path involving resentment, corpses, refinement, coffins, and control.
Discover an entry to corpse cultivation
Obtain or use a genuine corpse-path item; its deeper branches unlock contextually.
