guidance.immortal_cultivation_mod.chapte: Forging Branch · Special Flames
Each spiritual flame has its own nature. Different flames suit different weapons.
Discover a special flame
Find any special flame in the world and approach closely enough to identify it.
Identify the flame
Observe its name, color, strength, and properties. The eight special flames have different appearances and forging capabilities.
Check flame sources

Crimson Flame: dropped by Crimson Scale Flame Lizards, or refined from crimson scales and flame-lizard blood.
Earthlung Flame: underground lava and mountain fire vents.
Verdant Spirit Flame: lightning striking mature spirit wood.
Golden Yang True Flame: Golden Core or stronger Metal/Fire cultivators, ruins, and Daoist temples.
Nether Yin Flame: may appear when powerful undead die.
Thunder Flame: weapon-tribulation lightning striking lava or fire.
Dragon Flame: may appear after defeating or capturing a Crimson Sky Flame Dragon's escaped spirit, or refined from dragon horns and Nascent Soul beast cores.
Purple Heaven Flame: extremely rare after surviving a powerful weapon tribulation.
Check forging requirements
Inspect a forging recipe that requires a special flame. Forging cannot proceed properly if the required temperature exceeds your flame's capacity.
Use a stronger flame
Find a flame that can reach the required temperature and use it for forging.
Forging Branch · Flame Vessel
A Flame Vessel can contain a spiritual flame and unleash its power directly.
Craft a Flame Vessel
Craft an empty Flame Vessel using its recipe.
Capture a flame
Hold an empty Flame Vessel and right-click a floating flame that can be captured.
Inspect the captured flame
Read the vessel tooltip to check the flame type, power, stability, and highest forging tier. Shooting does not deplete the captured flame.
Release the flame
Sneak and right-click with a filled Flame Vessel to release the flame at the selected location.
Shoot flame
Right-click the Flame Vessel to spend Qi on a flame attack.
Charge the flame
Hold right-click to concentrate the flame. Firing consumes Qi; insufficient Qi prevents further charging.
Release a giant fireball
Release right-click after charging to launch a giant fireball. Holding until fully charged fires automatically. Charged attacks cost more Qi.
Forging Branch · Spiritual Flame Forging
Flames determine both furnace temperature and whether certain materials can truly melt.
Place fire beneath the cauldron

Shoot a filled Flame Vessel at supported empty ground, then place a forging cauldron directly above the resulting fire. Sneak-right-click releases a floating, capturable seed instead of the fire used beneath a cauldron.
Observe the temperature
Open the forging cauldron and check the temperature supplied by the current flame.
Choose a suitable flame
If the temperature cannot meet the recipe requirement, switch to a stronger or more suitable flame.
Maintain the spiritual fire
Ground fire fades over time and burns longer directly beneath a forging cauldron. Floating, capturable flame seeds do not expire on this timer.
Complete spiritual flame forging
Successfully complete a full forging process using a special flame.
Combat Branch · Giant Fireball
Highly concentrated spiritual fire has destructive power far beyond ordinary techniques.
Charge the Flame Vessel
Hold right-click with a filled Flame Vessel until a large fireball forms. Release to fire, or keep holding to fire automatically at full charge. Firing requires enough Qi.
Hit the target area
Release a giant fireball and let its explosion affect the target area.
Observe the explosion radius
A giant fireball can damage multiple creatures within its radius.
Observe terrain destruction
The explosion can destroy terrain and affect liquids within its radius.
Check block-breaking settings
Disable Flame Vessel terrain destruction under Block Breaking in Cultivation Settings. Attacks still damage creatures, but do not destroy terrain.
Weapons Branch · Restrictions and Advancement
A true spiritual weapon is not finished in a single forging. Restrictions are engraved layer by layer until they form a complete cycle.
Inspect weapon restrictions
Check the current restriction layers and advancement progress of a spiritual weapon that can grow.
Add a restriction layer
Successfully engrave one restriction on a weapon through the appropriate forging system.
Complete a restriction cycle
Keep strengthening the weapon until its current restriction cycle is complete.
Attempt weapon advancement
After completing a cycle, start advancement in the weapon enhancement screen. This immediately begins a weapon tribulation.
Summon a weapon tribulation
Advancing a spiritual weapon calls down heavenly lightning. Prepare to bear the trial while holding the weapon, or risk the weapon taking the strikes itself.
Weapons Branch · Weapon Tribulations
A spiritual weapon must endure heavenly lightning to advance. Its wielder can bear the trial, or the weapon can face it alone.
Begin a weapon tribulation
Meet the weapon advancement requirements and actively begin the lightning trial.
Hold the weapon through the trial
Keep the target weapon in your hand when lightning falls. The wielder takes the strikes first.
Survive the lightning trial
Withstand consecutive lightning strikes until the weapon completes its tribulation.
Understand letting go
If no one holds the weapon, lightning strikes it directly and reduces its durability.
Prevent the weapon from shattering
A weapon shatters when its durability reaches zero. Make sure it is in good enough condition before attempting the trial.
Understand death during the trial
If the wielder dies during a weapon tribulation, the trial weapon always drops into the world, even with keepInventory enabled.
Weapons Branch · Weapon Shards
A spiritual weapon may break, but it does not vanish completely. Its remaining shards still remember the weapon they belonged to.
Obtain a weapon shard
Shatter a spiritual weapon or obtain a weapon shard from another source.
Identify the shard
Inspect its information. Weapon shards retain details that identify their original weapon.
Collect all matching shards
Collect every matching shard required to reforge that weapon.
Prepare reforging materials
Prepare two stacks of spirit stones in addition to all matching shards.
Reforge the spiritual weapon
Use all matching shards and two stacks of spirit stones in the appropriate forging system to restore the shattered weapon.
Use shards in forging
If you do not plan to restore the original weapon, some weapon shards can serve as materials for other forging recipes.
Breakthrough Branch · Golden Core Failure and Recovery
Failing to form a Golden Core does not always mean returning to Foundation Establishment. Some cultivators have already taken half a step beyond it.
Fail a Golden Core trial

After dying during a Golden Core lightning trial, inspect the consequences of a cracked core and the Half-Step Golden Core realm. This branch unlocks when a cracked core appears; you do not need to fail deliberately.
Inspect the cracked Golden Core
Open your cultivation status. Death during a Golden Core trial leaves a cracked core and puts you in the Half-Step Golden Core realm.
Check recovery requirements
Check the recovery requirements for attempting Golden Core again with a cracked core.
Restore breakthrough readiness
Half-Step Golden Core requires twice the cultivation progress of Late Foundation Establishment, plus any other breakthrough conditions shown in the screen.
Attempt Golden Core again
Once ready, start the Golden Core trial again. The previous failure does not count as a successful breakthrough.
Alchemy Branch · Using Pills
Pills do more than restore health. They can affect breakthroughs, Qi, physical condition, or special systems.
Obtain a pill
Obtain any pill with a cultivation effect.
Read the pill description
Check its purpose, duration, and activation conditions.
Take a pill
Consume a pill when its use requirements are met.
Activate a pill effect
Let the pill's actual effect activate at least once.
Learn conditional pill effects
Some pills do not take full effect immediately. They activate during a breakthrough, injury, low Qi, or another specified condition.
Check remaining effects
Open the status screen to check active pill effects and their remaining duration.
Soul Branch · Thoughts and Control Resistance
Cultivators can spend Thoughts to retain control under spiritual suppression, illusions, and other control effects.
Suffer a control effect
Be affected by a control ability that consumes Thoughts.
Resist with Thoughts
Spend Thoughts while the effect lasts to reduce or escape its control.
Observe Thought consumption
Watch your Thoughts decrease while resisting.
Understand depleted Thoughts
Once Thoughts run out, you can no longer resist control, making further control effects more dangerous. Reading this tip is enough; do not deliberately exhaust your Thoughts.
Restore Thoughts
Let your Thoughts recover after escaping control and ongoing consumption.
Keep Thoughts in reserve
When facing several enemies with control abilities, avoid spending all your Thoughts on the first effect.
World Branch · Life Simulation
A cultivator's life holds more than meditation and battle. A single choice can change the opportunities that follow.
Begin a life simulation
Enter the Life Simulation system and create a new simulation.
Make a choice
Read an event and choose one of its actions.
Complete several events
Continue the simulation and let earlier decisions influence the life that follows.
Inspect simulation rewards
Once settlement is available, inspect the rewards from this simulation.
Settle manually
Choose Manual Settlement when available to end the current simulation early.
Claim the simulation result
Confirm settlement and receive the actual rewards produced by this simulated life.
World Branch · Hair Styling Table
The cultivation journey is long, and a cultivator's appearance need not stay the same forever.
Open the Hair Styling Table
Interact with a placed Hair Styling Table.
Change hairstyle
Choose a new available hairstyle and preview your character's appearance.
Adjust hair color
Change the current hair color and observe the live preview.
Use a skin reference
Load an available skin reference so the hairstyle matches your character's skin properly.
Save your appearance
Confirm the changes to apply the new hairstyle and color to your character.
Equipment Branch · Protective Accessories
Protective accessories have their own slots and provide special effects when their conditions are met.
Open accessory slots
Open your character equipment screen and find the protective accessory slots.
Equip a Fortune Guarding Coin
Place a Fortune Guarding Coin in a valid accessory slot. It consumes itself to protect you from misfortune it can block.
Equip a Shieldbreaker Ring
Place a Shieldbreaker Ring in a ring slot and hit a blocking enemy with a melee attack to break their guard.
Equip a Blood Fang Pendant
Place a Blood Fang Pendant in a necklace slot. Blood-demon cultivators or living corpses carrying blood or blood crystals can let it replenish low Blood Qi or Resentment automatically.
Equip an Enlightenment Leaf
Place an Enlightenment Leaf in a charm slot. Meditate to practice a method or practice spells to activate its proficiency bonus.
Change protective accessories
Choose accessories for your current enemies, cultivation method, or goal instead of always using the same equipment.
Equip a protective accessory
Open the equipment screen and place any protective accessory in its matching slot.
Check the required flame
Check the target temperature and flame requirements. Ordinary fire cannot refine every material.
Supply fire to the cauldron
Place a usable fire beneath the cauldron. Open it, start forging, and stoke the flame to raise the temperature.
Check breakthrough consequences
Some failed breakthroughs do not simply return you to your previous state. Open cultivation status to check your realm, injuries, and the conditions for another attempt.

toxicity.detox.amount: Removes %s pill toxicity; adds no toxicity.
toxicity.stats.restore: Pill healing / Qi restored: %s%% of normal
toxicity.stats.benefit: Other numeric pill benefits: %s%% of normal

guidance.immortal_cultivation_mod.chapte: Pill Toxicity
Know when medicine becomes poison.
Sources and repeat use

Every successfully consumed pill adds toxicity once, including doses that restore over time. Potency and quality use current server rules, even for old saved pills. Default base gain is 4 × pill potency; common / fine / superior quality multiply it by 1 / 0.75 / 0.5. Pills have a configured medicinal realm (most ordinary pills: Qi Refining; breakthrough pill: Foundation). Each realm above you multiplies toxicity by 1.75; each below multiplies it by 0.85. Saved pill realm metadata, when present, is respected. Each earlier repeat of the SAME pill in a chain that resets after 120 online seconds without that pill adds 35%% gain, up to five repeats. Different pill types track separately. The tooltip previews your next gain.
Stages and warnings

Default stages: 0–19 Pure; 20–39 Mild; 40–59 Accumulated; 60–79 Meridian Poisoning; 80–100 Marrow Poisoning. Screen corners begin with green mist, progressing to green-purple edges, slow purple veins and deep violet miasma. The aiming center stays clear. A brief edge label announces a worse stage; recovery allows a later warning. Open Pill Toxicity from statistics for the ACTUAL server multipliers. Open Toxicity Visual Settings from the main configuration menu or toxicity details page to disable screen effects or adjust opacity (default 60%%). Mist and veins blend continuously with your actual toxicity; the center stays clear. These client settings change no mechanics.
Total penalties

Each stage uses its total multiplier once. Mild: pill healing/Qi 90%%. Accumulated: healing/Qi 75%%, other numeric pill benefits 90%%, natural Qi 85%%. Meridian: 60%% / 80%% / 70%%, cultivation 85%%, spell costs 115%%. Marrow: 40%% / 65%% / 50%%, cultivation 65%%, spell costs 130%%; lose 1%% maximum HP every 10 seconds, never below 1 HP. Trigger chances, permanent legacy unlocks and fixed vanilla effects retain their behavior. Restoration penalties apply to instant and ongoing doses without compounding per tick. Natural Qi and pill restoration are separate.
Recovering safely

Online play removes 0.01 points/second. Meditation adds 0.04 points/second. Leaving meditation stops the bonus; damage interrupts meditation and blocks its bonus for 5 seconds. No offline detox. Death clears toxicity and repeat records; logout and changing dimensions do not. Qingdu Pill removes 25 points, adds no toxicity, requires Qi Refining or higher, and has a server-enforced 300-second ONLINE cooldown. During cooldown, below its realm requirement, or while already clean, it cannot be consumed. Its tooltip shows the limit and remaining time.
Qingdu formula

Refine 3 Harmonizing Herbs, 2 Spirit Spring Leaves and 1 Profound Ice Lotus using the Qingdu Pill Formula at 1200°C in a ding. Base yield: 5. Obtain the formula through the usual formula shop or merchant routes. All numbers here describe defaults; server config may change them. Statistics and tooltips show your current server rules.

life.story.rain_sword.title: The Sword at the Rain Crossing
life.story.rain_sword.opening:
At Rain Ferry, your request for a crossing brings you instead to a rusted sword. A voice asks whether the boat has returned. The ferryman stops at the sound.

He: “Duan died here forty-three years ago. I promised to return for him and came only at dawn. If you'll listen, I'll tell the part I used to omit.”
life.story.rain_sword.evidence:
He produces a wooden token. Duan left his grain-guarding post to protect civilians at the ferry. Three names have arrival marks; the lowest line is blurred.

He: “Those three lived for years afterward. Read this carefully before calling people who arrived safely trapped in the river.”
life.story.rain_sword.choice.a: “Reconstruct the final crossing and stabilize it in stages.”
life.story.rain_sword.choice.b: “Attempt release, accepting that failure leaves the bound sword to handle.”
life.story.rain_sword.choice.c: “Challenge the guardian and take the sword by force.”
life.story.rain_sword.decision:
The nighttime passenger images are old impressions in the sword and do not answer. The remnant does, asking who still needs to cross.

He: “He was the one left behind. We can attempt the crossing or release the oath. If release fails to settle it, the bound sword will have to be moved without pretending farewell is complete.”
life.story.rain_sword.a:
As the boat lands, He calls Duan's name. The remnant stops asking, and rust falls from the blade.

He: “This arrival belongs to today. Don't make it look completed forty-three years ago.” He gives you the sword and adds the new mark himself.
life.story.rain_sword.a.later: The token preserves the old failure and adds the date of the crossing actually completed.
life.story.rain_sword.b:
You preserve the names and He's account of failing to return, then give the token to the river. The oath loosens and the sword dissolves into pale light.

He keeps the copy. “I'll read this first when anyone asks.” What remains is an account, not a weapon to collect.
life.story.rain_sword.b.later: The names remain at the ferry and the token in the river; release leaves no sword to collect.
life.story.rain_sword.c:
The remnant does not settle. The sword is finally carried away from the bank. The water returns to ordinary sounds, but the question inside the blade remains.

He: “I'll record that you took the sword. I cannot write that the final boat returned.”
life.story.rain_sword.c.later: The sword leaves the ferry with its unresolved oath and consequences intact.
life.story.rain_sword.withdrawn: You return the token and explain where your work stopped. He preserves the evidence without calling withdrawal a successful release. The question rises from the bank again, leaving him another night to face.
life.story.missing_disciple.title: The Disciple Who Did Not Return
life.story.missing_disciple.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.missing_disciple.opening:
A notice calls Lin a deserter, but his cloak still hangs in his room. The worker collecting his medicine tray points beneath the bed and asks you to look before believing the notice.

The note says they are feeding the array. Nursing his arm, the worker says, “I know he never packed. Someone needs to check the rest.”
life.story.missing_disciple.continue: “Preserve the note and trace Lin and the medicine.”
life.story.missing_disciple.withdraw: “Withdraw and hand over what is known.”
life.story.missing_disciple.evidence:
The accounts place the same medicine batch at two destinations. The worker carried it beneath the garden, where returning disciples struggled to stand.

Worker: “I can confirm my route. Check the approvals yourself rather than asking me to guess.” The office is gathering copies for destruction.
life.story.missing_disciple.rush: “Find Lin first, leaving the accounts unverified.”
life.story.missing_disciple.choice.a: “Free Lin in the proper sequence and preserve evidence.”
life.story.missing_disciple.choice.b: “Attempt a private replacement of the living source.”
life.story.missing_disciple.choice.c: “Accuse the steward using the evidence currently available.”
life.story.missing_disciple.decision:
Lin is alive but connected to the array. When you reach for him, he stops you. “Don't pull. The return flow is still connected.”

Xie admits sealed reserve stones can temporarily replace a living source. A guard controls access, while the surviving accounts will determine what accusations can be supported. Rescue and accountability require separate work.
life.story.missing_disciple.a:
After the supply stops, healers take Lin into care. Site records and surviving accounts reach the elder, and the night-duty system is ordered to change.

Lin asks whether anyone else will be sent below. You read the prohibition on living supply without calling his injuries healed.
life.story.missing_disciple.a.later: Rescue and reform are recorded separately, with public evidence preventing the old night duty from remaining hidden.
life.story.missing_disciple.b:
Reserve power lets Lin leave the seat. Not all records are disclosed; Xie stores them in a sealed chest.

Lin pauses at the door. “Getting out doesn't mean it never happened. Keep your account. I'll ask again.”
life.story.missing_disciple.b.later: Lin is rescued, while undisclosed responsibility remains part of the compromise.
life.story.missing_disciple.c:
The intervention lacks a complete evidentiary basis, and the dispute first produces a sanction against you. The worker follows to ask about an appeal. Important gaps remain in the file.

Worker: “The sanction concerns you. Lin's condition still needs checking. One decision can't make everything else somebody else's problem.”
life.story.missing_disciple.c.later: The sanction coexists with unfinished fact-finding; any appeal must address the incomplete record.
life.story.missing_disciple.withdrawn: You give the worker the note and your actual findings, distinguishing what remains unverified. He seeks someone else willing to inspect below the garden, without recording your departure as a completed rescue.
life.story.borrowed_faces.title: The Market of Borrowed Faces
life.story.borrowed_faces.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.borrowed_faces.opening:
In the ghost market's memory shop, a spirit named Yuexi asks you to inspect her contract. The keeper holds the true-name register and will not let her reach the door.

Yuexi: “I lent him a memory, not my name. You needn't believe me first. Look for what was added.”
life.story.borrowed_faces.evidence:
Yuexi recognizes her mark but not the name-transfer clause. Two ink shades suggest a change, though proving it requires checking the binding terms.

When the clerk reaches for it, she holds the edge. “My signature doesn't authorize everything you might add afterward.”
life.story.borrowed_faces.choice.a: “Undo the unlawful transfer and restore the true name.”
life.story.borrowed_faces.choice.b: “Pay a hundred wealth for memory under explicit terms.”
life.story.borrowed_faces.choice.c: “Take the register despite its guardians and resulting claims.”
life.story.borrowed_faces.decision:
Two mirror attendants guard the register. The merchant separates Yuexi's name dispute from any memory you borrow: payment or repayment terms must be explicit.

Yuexi: “My claim isn't a discount you can spend on your own purchase.” The merchant separates the two documents.
life.story.borrowed_faces.a:
The transfer clause is established as a later addition, and the keeper must restore the name under the original agreement. Yuexi gives you a contact token.

Yuexi: “Use my own name when you want me. Don't ask them to agree for me again.”
life.story.borrowed_faces.a.later: Yuexi regains her name. Your signature records verification of the original agreement, nothing more.
life.story.borrowed_faces.b:
The memory's scope and repayment terms are written clearly, with copies retained. Yuexi's dispute remains separate from your completed bargain.

The merchant offers the agreed memory. “Read the margin too. At collection, I won't read only the half you liked.”
life.story.borrowed_faces.b.later: The loan has defined scope and repayment terms. The unresolved name dispute remains independent.
life.story.borrowed_faces.c:
When negotiations collapse, the mirror attendants move to reclaim the disputed register. You keep it while withdrawing to the market entrance. The merchant records a claim as the book and memories leave with you.

Trading resumes behind you, but the notices about you remain.
life.story.borrowed_faces.c.later: Taking the register prompts the market to investigate and pursue its whereabouts.
life.story.borrowed_faces.withdrawn: You explain the clauses you actually saw without touching the register again. Yuexi thanks you for that and asks the clerk to preserve the original while she seeks another witness.
life.story.flooded_mine.title: The Mine Beneath the Water
life.story.flooded_mine.opening:
Miners stop you on the mountain road. Water covers the loading platform, but Foreman Zhou still wants the final carts. At the entrance, a water spirit appears from a fissure and calls itself Lian.

Lian: “You've cut through the watercourse. Move that lower support and the escape route goes first.” Hearing workers still inside, Zhou finally stops the cart.
life.story.flooded_mine.withdraw: “Withdraw and report what was seen at the entrance.”
life.story.flooded_mine.evidence:
Three supports tremble as water advances toward the low exit. A miner asks Zhou whether to abandon the cart. The foreman stares at its wheels without answering.

Lian shows you the pressure array. “If you'll repair it, understand how the supports share the load. Don't plug every leak blindly.”
life.story.flooded_mine.choice.a: “Stabilize the reservoir in stages, with evacuation on failure.”
life.story.flooded_mine.choice.b: “Evacuate the miners, then seal the entrance.”
life.story.flooded_mine.choice.c: “Continue extracting ore despite the risk to the watercourse.”
life.story.flooded_mine.decision:
Lian proposes a jointly maintained reservoir, stabilized in three stages. Two accumulated failures require evacuation, without gambling on another support.

Zhou finally asks whether the workers want to abandon the cart. One has already loosened his harness, waiting for repair, closure or further mining.
life.story.flooded_mine.a:
The level finally falls. Lian and Zhou agree on extraction limits and maintenance. The miners ask that both appear on the same document.

Zhou notes that monthly output will be lower. A miner answers, “Fewer carts are fine if we know we'll get out next time.”
life.story.flooded_mine.a.later: Extraction limits and shared maintenance become obligations in one reservoir agreement.
life.story.flooded_mine.b:
After the last miner emerges, everyone is counted again before the entrance is sealed. Zhou watches the abandoned cart in silence.

A miner drops his soaked harness. “Tell the families we're all here. Worry about the cart tomorrow.”
life.story.flooded_mine.b.later: The evacuation list confirms all personnel before recording closure and lost work.
life.story.flooded_mine.c:
When the ore comes out, Lian no longer answers. Zhou counts the yield while cracks continue along the watercourse.

Someone asks whether the mine can be entered again. Nobody uses the value of today's ore as an answer.
life.story.flooded_mine.c.later: The ore produces gains alongside the continuing consequences of the damaged watercourse.
life.story.flooded_mine.withdrawn: You reach the entrance before it floods and report the cracks and water level. Zhou must still decide about the remaining workers. Your departure is not recorded as their rescue.
life.story.future_letter.title: A Letter from a Possible Future
life.story.future_letter.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.future_letter.opening:
A letter without a return address arrives in handwriting and with a signature resembling yours. It tells you to abandon a scarred medicine courier by the bridge, seek treasure in the observatory and accept his death at a stated hour.

The ink is still damp. You wipe a stain from your finger without treating the familiar signature as proof.
life.story.future_letter.continue: “Verify the people and places in the letter.”
life.story.future_letter.choice.evidence: “Compare the letter's claims with the facts.”
life.story.future_letter.evidence:
The scarred courier is about to cross a bridge with a cracked support. You show him the letter and ask him to wait safely while you check the nearby observatory.

Courier: “I can wait a while, not a day. Find out whether the bridge is safe, not whether the letter sounds impressive.”
life.story.future_letter.rush: “Keep the doubts in mind and pursue the source.”
life.story.future_letter.choice.a: “Return to protect the courier rather than wait for the predicted death.”
life.story.future_letter.choice.b: “Study the contradictions, accepting sale as curios if interpretation fails.”
life.story.future_letter.decision:
The observatory holds dozens of letters with conflicting endings. An echo resembling you offers no consistent answer. A collector offers space to study them; if they cannot be interpreted, he will buy them as miscellaneous curios.

The courier still waits. You can prioritize rescue, study the branches, sell the letters or confront the echo.
life.story.future_letter.a:
You get the courier clear of the bridge danger. He checks the medicine, then asks about the alternate route.

Courier: “Keep the letter for study. I still have medicine to deliver. Thank you for the part that helped today.”
life.story.future_letter.a.later: The predicted hour passes; the actual account records the courier's rescue.
life.story.future_letter.b:
You sort the letters by place and conditions rather than forcing them into one future. Contradictions remain marked as clues requiring verification.

However much the echo resembles you, it cannot bear the consequences of your present choices.
life.story.future_letter.b.later: The preserved letters offer branches useful for preparation, not an inevitable timetable.
life.story.future_letter.c:
The letters pass to the collector. He pays the agreed price and records what you said about their origin. As you leave, he is asking another customer about the places they mention.

The sale is settled, along with the disclosure of movements contained in the letters.
life.story.future_letter.c.later: The collector acquires both letters and the movements they reveal; the transaction extends beyond its price.
life.story.future_letter.withdrawn: You put away the letter and leave the observatory unexplored. Those at the bridge must still address the courier's situation. Your name at the bottom gives the letter no authority over you.
life.story.heretic_orphan.title: The Heretic's Orphan
life.story.heretic_orphan.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.heretic_orphan.opening:
When you arrive at the sect to report your journey, Officer Wen is holding a bundle of medicinal herbs. The young woman who delivered it has given her name twice without getting it back.

“Shen He. Nineteen. An apprentice at the South Street pharmacy,” she says, struggling to stay patient. “Someone is waiting for that delivery. Open it if you think the herbs are wrong.” Wen instead asks about her late father, who was hunted for practicing forbidden arts.
life.story.heretic_orphan.continue: Stay and ask why she is being held
life.story.heretic_orphan.withdraw: Explain that you cannot remain involved
life.story.heretic_orphan.choice.evidenc: Check what the old file actually proves
life.story.heretic_orphan.evidence:
Wen produces the old case file. People pursuing her father's debts may come to the sect, he says. You read several pages without finding testimony that implicates Shen He.

“I'm afraid they'll come too,” Shen He says. “That's why I used the front gate and gave my name. Investigate what I've actually done, but give me somewhere to answer for myself.”
life.story.heretic_orphan.rush: Hear the enforcement team's proposed arrangement
life.story.heretic_orphan.choice.a: Escort her to supervised sanctuary, resisting the officers if necessary
life.story.heretic_orphan.choice.b: Negotiate a public hearing with a deadline and a right of appeal
life.story.heretic_orphan.choice.c: Make service a condition of protection
life.story.heretic_orphan.decision:
Wen can request temporary sanctuary or arrange a hearing during supervised detention. If neither is agreed, the team intends to make Shen He work to cover the cost of taking her in. She asks how long. Wen has no answer.

“Don't agree on my behalf,” she tells you. “If this is protection, tell me when I'm allowed to leave.” The officers have arrived to collect her, and you must decide whether to intervene.
life.story.heretic_orphan.a: When the sanctuary clerk asks about her father, Shen He puts down her apprenticeship papers. “Start with this. This is what I've done.” The clerk reads them and adds arrangements for her medical studies. She checks the rules for coming and going before signing.
life.story.heretic_orphan.a.later: Shen He later sends word through the pharmacy that she has resumed assisting with consultations. The sanctuary remains under the agreed supervision.
life.story.heretic_orphan.b: The hearing has yet to begin, and Shen He cannot leave for now. She copies the detention deadline and the appeal contact's name, then has Wen sign both copies. “I'll ask again when this date comes. Have an answer for me.”
life.story.heretic_orphan.b.later: Both sides keep a copy of the hearing agreement, giving Shen He a deadline against which to demand progress.
life.story.heretic_orphan.c: When the service agreement arrives, Shen He asks where she could go if she refused. No one answers. After a while, she picks up the brush. She performs her duties afterward, but with you she discusses only work, never her own plans.
life.story.heretic_orphan.c.later: The enforcement record notes that she accepted service without another placement available. Payment has been settled, but the circumstances still shape how she treats you.
life.story.heretic_orphan.withdrawn: You tell Shen He what you could establish and explain that you cannot stand as her guarantor. She takes back the herbs and turns to Wen. “Then let's keep talking. First tell me where you intend to take me.”
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.title: The Shop That Pawned Tomorrow
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.opening:
Wen Su examines you before placing a contract on her pharmacy counter. Patients unable to pay can offer a portion of their future time instead. Before you can ask the price, a girl calls for her mother from the back room.

Wen Su answers instinctively, then explains in a quieter voice. “That's a voice kept inside the clock. My daughter died. Each time the hourglass turns, she comes through the door in that same moment.”
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.continue: Ask about the hourglasses and the treatment contract
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.choice.eviden: Examine how the hourglasses trap the same moment
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.evidence:
The clock's hands are still, but three hourglasses take turns running. The girl's image enters, sets down a school bag, calls for her mother, then vanishes. Wen Su waits until the room is quiet before speaking again.

“The borrowed time goes here,” she says. “It hasn't brought her back. It's only made me afraid to turn it off. If you understand this mechanism, see whether it can still be repaired.”
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.choice.a: Attempt repairs, accepting contracted treatment if they fail
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.choice.b: Accept treatment in exchange for one action next year
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.choice.c: Destroy the clock spirit, accepting damage to the pharmacy
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.decision:
Wen Su will let you repair the hourglasses, though that would end the repetition. If repairs fail, she can still treat you under a contract costing one action next year. If the clock spirit breaks loose, destroying it will damage the pharmacy as well.

She also brings out a Soul-Concealing Pill. “Someone left this to settle a debt. It may contain a remnant soul. I won't sell it as ordinary medicine. Think carefully before taking it.”
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.a: As the last sand falls, Wen Su stands by the door and listens to her daughter's final call. The clock moves forward at last. She wipes her eyes and opens the window facing the street. When the pharmacy reopens days later, she asks you to help sort her neglected alchemy notes.
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.a.later: The reopened pharmacy charges its usual fees, and the clock runs again. Wen Su still glances toward the door sometimes, but she no longer turns the hourglasses.
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.b: Once the medicine takes effect, Wen Su brings both copies of the contract for you to check. They specify one action next year and contain no automatic extension. She keeps her copy and places yours on the medicine parcel. “Keep it. This is what we'll settle by next year.”
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.b.later: The treatment is complete. The single action stipulated in the contract remains due next year.
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.c: The shelves collapse as the clock spirit disperses. Wen Su comes outside, makes sure the repeated voice has stopped, and asks her neighbors to secure the damaged building. She stays to assess her losses. By the time you leave, the pharmacy is locked.
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.c.later: Wen Su is free of the clock spirit, but the pharmacy remains closed while she works out the repairs.
life.story.pawned_tomorrow.withdrawn: Wen Su puts away the unsigned contract and returns the medicine to its shelf. As you say goodbye, sand begins running again. She looks toward the back room but stays at the counter until you have left.
life.story.heart_steps.title: The Steps That Asked No Question
life.story.heart_steps.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.heart_steps.opening:
At a flight of old stone steps, a guardian remnant appears beside the path. It asks you to hear the rules before entering. The trial may question you about past events or present a situation that has never happened.

“I'll tell you when a scene is invented,” it says. “You needn't confess to things you never did, or tell me what you think I want to hear just to reach the top.”
life.story.heart_steps.continue: Hear the rules and examine the trial
life.story.heart_steps.withdraw: Stop answering and withdraw from the trial
life.story.heart_steps.choice.evidence: Examine honestly what you could have judged at the time
life.story.heart_steps.evidence: The remnant pauses an image before the steps and asks whether you recognize the event. Only after its origin is established does it continue. “What could you know at the time? Don't assume that everything you've learned since was already clear then.”
life.story.heart_steps.choice.a: Reassess the situation and attempt another approach
life.story.heart_steps.choice.b: Fight through the obstacles to the summit
life.story.heart_steps.decision:
This time, the remnant explicitly presents a hypothetical scene. Someone calls for help below while a door slowly closes at the summit. You cannot rush upward and bring that person out at the same time.

“You can turn back or call for help. If you see another way, show me,” the remnant says, stepping aside. “Just don't invent a kinder reason for yourself afterward.”
life.story.heart_steps.a: You explain both your judgment and your hesitation, including what you still cannot be sure of. The remnant reveals the path only after listening. “That will do. Next time, you'll at least know what to ask first.” As you leave, a question that has long troubled you begins to loosen its hold.
life.story.heart_steps.a.later: The trial preserves your whole answer, including its doubts. When recalling it later, you leave those doubts in.
life.story.heart_steps.b: The ascent ends, and the repeated obstacles have taught you more about your movement and timing. The remnant leaves its earlier question unanswered and asks you to remember it. You sit at the summit for a while before descending.
life.story.heart_steps.b.later: The skill gained on the ascent stays with you, along with the question you have yet to resolve.
life.story.heart_steps.c: You return to the mountain path, and the cries fade with the illusion. The remnant does not follow to urge another attempt. Farther down the road, you are still considering the moment you turned: whether you yielded too soon or finally recognized a limit.
life.story.heart_steps.c.later: Leaving becomes a starting point for later reflection. The trial itself remains unfinished.
life.story.heart_steps.withdrawn: You tell the remnant that you do not wish to discuss these matters further. It dismisses the images and clears the original path. No one stops you, and no final answer is required before you leave.
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.title: The Caravan's Unfinished Contract
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.objec: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.openi:
At the relay station, Merchant Luo asks you to escort a sealed wooden crate containing a spiritual artifact ordered by a Black Crane buyer. While you read the shipping note, a voice inside interrupts. “Don't accept yet. He hasn't told you what they're sending me there for.”

Luo explains that the speaker is Qiuyue, the artifact's spirit, as though describing a feature of the cargo. Through the wood, she asks, “If you're hiring an escort, why can't I hear the terms too?”
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.conti: Ask Luo to produce the full contract
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.withd: End your involvement in the escort
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.choic: Check the signatures and cancellation terms
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.evide:
An attached agreement grants the buyer forty years of service. No mark of Qiuyue's consent appears beside her name. Luo says this is how the trade has always worked. “Does no one asking before mean I agreed?” she replies.

The contract binds the caravan and its buyer. You have not accepted the escort or sworn a blood oath.
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.rush: Ask Luo directly how the bindings can be removed
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.choic: Expose the contract and fight the guards who intervene
Offer one hundred wealth to negotiate Qiuyue's freedom
Accept the arrangement and deliver the crate
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.decis:
The receiving guards arrive and tell Luo to bring the crate over. He names a cancellation price of one hundred wealth. The guards warn that exposing the arrangement will be treated as an attempt to seize their property.

Qiuyue listens from inside. “Pay them or bring witnesses, but let me leave when it's over. Don't just replace the person giving me orders.”
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.a: Before witnesses, Luo takes payment and signs a release freeing Qiuyue from every buyer's service. She checks the final line before thanking you. “You can ask me to travel with you another time. Today I'd like to walk a little on my own.”
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.a.lat: Qiuyue keeps the release. In later dealings, she answers for herself whether she wishes to accompany you.
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.b: By the end of the confrontation, road witnesses have the contract, and Luo is forced to open the crate and remove the bindings. Qiuyue leaves with the witnesses. The Black Crane guards record your name and promise that someone will pursue the dispute.
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.b.lat: The contract's terms become known along the trade road. Qiuyue is free, and the buyer begins pursuing those who stopped the sale.
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.c: The buyer has you sign for delivery before paying. Hearing the money set on the table, Qiuyue asks whether her words simply were not worth the trouble. She says nothing more before the guards carry the crate away.
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.c.lat: Your name remains on the delivery record. Qiuyue remembers that you brought her to the buyer after hearing the full terms.
life.story.broken_caravan_contract.withd: Your part in the escort ends here. You state what you learned from the attached agreement and step away from the caravan's arrangements. The crate remains at the station, where Qiuyue continues demanding an answer from Luo.
life.story.silent_elder.title: The Elder Who Stopped Speaking
life.story.silent_elder.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.silent_elder.opening:
The sect asks you to examine the rift behind its mountain. Yunxia meets you outside the cordon and hands over Elder Han Xu's formation plan. Still holding the seal in place, the elder greets you with a short written note.

“He hasn't spoken for thirty years,” Yunxia explains. “The formation seizes spoken promises from him and turns them into new anchors. I suspect someone altered the maintenance orders. We need to ask while he can still spare a hand to write.”
life.story.silent_elder.continue: Use the plan to ask about the maintenance
life.story.silent_elder.withdraw: Hand your findings to Yunxia and withdraw
life.story.silent_elder.choice.evidence: Interpret his notes and find the altered arrangements
life.story.silent_elder.evidence: Han Xu copies the original orders into the plan's margin for comparison. As you prepare to ask a question, Yunxia cautions you. “Ask, but don't press him for a spoken assurance. Let him finish writing.” The elder nods and continues marking the anchors.
life.story.silent_elder.rush: Discuss how to respond if the rift expands
life.story.silent_elder.choice.a: Organize volunteer guardians and upkeep costing twenty wealth each year
life.story.silent_elder.choice.b: Coordinate evacuation and preserve as many texts as possible
life.story.silent_elder.choice.c: Fight the constructs and risk drawing power from the rift
life.story.silent_elder.decision:
The guardian constructs turn on the anchors. Han Xu drops his brush and braces the formation with both hands. Yunxia reads his last instructions: volunteers may share the burden, with twenty wealth required each year for upkeep. If that cannot be organized, the sect must withdraw in the prescribed order.

Some escaping power can be taken from the rift, at a cost to whoever takes it and to the surrounding mountain. Yunxia watches the constructs approach. “Whether we stay or leave, someone has to act now.”
life.story.silent_elder.a: Once the first volunteers take over, Han Xu can sit outside the formation's center. He gives you a limited continuation of a cultivation manual, then points to the upkeep ledger. Only when the annual twenty wealth is accounted for does he close it. Yunxia still has shifts to arrange, but the sect can remain.
life.story.silent_elder.a.later: The new duty roster operates alongside the upkeep fund. If payments cease, neglected anchors will again endanger the area.
life.story.silent_elder.b: After the last load of texts is carried out, Han Xu releases the old anchors in the planned order and withdraws with the guardians. Yunxia inventories the recovered books, listing missing volumes separately. “First we need somewhere to live. Then we can think about replacing these.”
life.story.silent_elder.b.later: The relocation saves part of the sect's inheritance, leaving missing volumes and rebuilding costs. Han Xu is no longer bound to the old formation.
life.story.silent_elder.c: Only a little of the rift's power is recovered, but the burning it leaves in your channels persists. Yunxia evacuates the wounded from the fractured mountain and sends people to assess the damage. The power will take time to absorb; its cost is already being paid.
life.story.silent_elder.c.later: The injuries and local damage are recorded. The power gained does not remove the need for recovery and further cultivation.
life.story.silent_elder.withdrawn: You return the plan to Yunxia, explaining what you understood and what remains uncertain. She puts it away and goes to find more guardians. From the formation's center, Han Xu gestures toward the safe route out.
life.story.tribulation.title: When the Heavens Answer
life.story.tribulation.objective: Body / meridians / will: stabilize three knots
life.story.tribulation.opening: The clouds gather on the day you prepare to break through. The attendant leads you to the tribulation platform, moves the spectators back, and asks whether you are ready. “You can still stop. Once you enter, I can respond to an emergency, but I can't take the lightning for you.” The first thunder is still distant.
life.story.tribulation.continue: Inspect the platform and your preparations
life.story.tribulation.choice.evidence: Prepare the formation and move others to safety
life.story.tribulation.evidence: Several connections around the platform need checking. You examine the perimeter and leave the retreat route clear. The attendant waits outside. “If you want a guardian, arrange it now. Don't wait for lightning to notice someone standing too close.” Your preparation and endurance will still decide the outcome.
life.story.tribulation.rush: Finish the inspection and decide whether to proceed
life.story.tribulation.choice.a: Face the three trials, accepting the risk of death
life.story.tribulation.choice.b: Stabilize your cultivation and postpone the breakthrough
life.story.tribulation.decision: As the clouds descend, three spiritual knots take shape, testing body, channels, and will in turn. From beyond the boundary, the attendant calls, “If you're withdrawing, do it now! Better to recover from what you've spent than wait until you can't move.” You may instead enter the tribulation, completing the knots or attempting to disperse the clouds.
life.story.tribulation.a: The last knot settles, and the thunder recedes. Only after the clouds disperse does the attendant come onto the platform to check you. You have crossed the threshold, though simply sitting upright takes effort. Learning the new realm will begin after recovery.
life.story.tribulation.a.later: The breakthrough enters your cultivation record, followed by pages of recovery and adjustment to your channels.
life.story.tribulation.b: You retreat before the knots close completely. The attendant takes you to shelter and helps assess your injuries and spent supplies. The breakthrough remains unfinished, but the problems revealed are enough to guide another attempt.
life.story.tribulation.b.later: The attempt ends in withdrawal. Your injuries need care, and another tribulation will require fresh preparation.
life.story.tribulation.c: The knots break one after another, and lightning consumes the retreat route. The attendant cannot reach the platform until the clouds clear, when the final events are entered in the memorial record. This simulated life ends here; your character outside the simulation is unaffected.
life.story.tribulation.c.later: The memorial record closes with the tribulation platform. No further journeys follow in this life.
life.story.tribulation.withdrawn: You tell the attendant your decision and collect the unused supplies. The platform closes as you leave, and the spectators disperse. The threshold can wait while you attend to your cultivation as it stands.
life.story.inner_demon.title: The Voice That Knows Your Name
life.story.inner_demon.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.inner_demon.opening: After days in seclusion, stopping cultivation no longer lets you sleep. A voice keeps returning to old events, demanding that you reconsider every mistake. Tonight it follows your breathing. “How can you rest when you still haven't worked it out?” You sit up, realizing this has become more than ordinary worry.
life.story.inner_demon.continue: Stop cultivating and examine the voice's source
life.story.inner_demon.withdraw: Stop this attempt and step back
life.story.inner_demon.choice.evidence: Distinguish real memories from exaggerated accusations
life.story.inner_demon.evidence: You consider the events it repeats. Some call for amends; others are self-blame magnified by exhaustion. Any old oath must be checked against its actual terms. The voice demands an immediate confession, but you first ask what really happened.
life.story.inner_demon.rush: Decide how to address the inner demon
life.story.inner_demon.choice.a: Acknowledge real mistakes without accepting false accusations
life.story.inner_demon.choice.b: Concentrate your strength to suppress it
life.story.inner_demon.choice.c: Pay one hundred wealth for care and rest
life.story.inner_demon.decision: The demon has learned your habits: each attempt to prove yourself blameless brings another accusation. Sorting facts or suppressing it by force may both exhaust you further. Care is available outside, with medicine and rest costing one hundred wealth. If you cannot manage alone, you will need that help.
life.story.inner_demon.a: You stop racing to answer every accusation. You name what needs repair and acknowledge your exhaustion. The demon waits for another argument, but you pause to settle your breathing. Eventually, only the wind outside remains, and you can sit in peace.
life.story.inner_demon.a.later: When similar self-reproach returns, you remember to establish the facts before deciding whether to make amends or rest.
life.story.inner_demon.b: The voice is quiet for now, and you can finally rest. As you end the exercise, the unresolved matter returns to mind. It still needs attention, though it no longer leaves you unable to breathe.
life.story.inner_demon.b.later: Suppression stops this episode. The underlying matter remains to be faced after recovery.
life.story.inner_demon.c: Your carers bring medicine regularly and postpone another practice session when you try to push too hard. They do not demand your whole history, but stay through the nights when remaining lucid is hardest. By the time the demon recedes, asking for help has become easier.
life.story.inner_demon.c.later: Medicine and recovery are provided for, and the experience of enduring those nights builds trust.
life.story.inner_demon.withdrawn: You end the confrontation and put your cultivation tools aside. Leaving the room does not resolve the past, but it stops you from exhausting yourself further. Rest and help still need to be arranged.
life.story.sect_invasion.title: The Night the Sect Burned
life.story.sect_invasion.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.sect_invasion.opening: The dispute between two sects has reached the mountain gate. In the outer court, disciples carry wounded people from a smoking corridor while others bring books they had no time to pack. A gate defender stops you. “Red Willow's troops are about to block the path. Can you hold them a little? We haven't got everyone out.”
life.story.sect_invasion.continue: Assess the attackers and the evacuation route
life.story.sect_invasion.withdraw: Pass on your observations and withdraw from the front
life.story.sect_invasion.choice.evidence: Examine the token to identify the enemy command and approach
life.story.sect_invasion.evidence: A wounded disciple picks up a military token beside the threshold and recognizes the Red Willow emblem. It confirms the attackers' affiliation, but their troops are still moving toward the path. The disciple puts it away. “We can submit evidence later. First we need to get people through.”
life.story.sect_invasion.choice.a: Hold the evacuation route for the wounded
life.story.sect_invasion.choice.b: Negotiate ceasefire terms with the Red Willow captain
life.story.sect_invasion.choice.c: Rescue whoever you can and abandon the old gate
life.story.sect_invasion.decision: The Red Willow captain sends another squad forward. The defender estimates the line can last six rounds and urges you to assign whoever can help. Holding the road may save more wounded people. If it fails, the survivors must abandon the old site with whatever texts they have. You may also attempt a ceasefire.
life.story.sect_invasion.a: The gate defender withdraws only after the final group passes through. In safety, everyone checks names and recovered books. One disciple is still clutching a bundle of singed scriptures. The gate needs rebuilding, but there is finally time to count and plan.
life.story.sect_invasion.a.later: The rescue roster and recovered texts are recorded, while damaged buildings enter a separate rebuilding ledger.
life.story.sect_invasion.b: The old gate cannot be kept. The disciples leave with the rescued people and recovered texts, some turning back at every bend. Shelter comes first, then an inventory of the inheritance. Much else must wait until everyone is settled.
life.story.sect_invasion.b.later: The relocation record lists the people and inheritance actually saved. Losses at the old site remain to be addressed.
life.story.sect_invasion.c: Once the ceasefire terms are confirmed, the Red Willow captain clears the path and the wounded can move again. The gate defender reads the sect's concessions without calling it an easy victory. Instead, they ask you to help count those leaving.
life.story.sect_invasion.c.later: The ceasefire changes the local balance of power and allows civilians to leave the likely reach of another clash.
life.story.sect_invasion.withdrawn: You tell the defender what you saw of the enemy's movement, then leave the front. They pass your information on and continue assigning people. The gate bell is still ringing; the evacuation is unfinished.
life.story.oath_collection.title: The Debt Written in Blood
life.story.oath_collection.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.oath_collection.opening: An oath collector arrives with the original agreement and asks you to verify your mark. He places the allegation of breach beside it, leaving the exceptions visible. “I'm here to settle this oath. If the allegation is wrong, bring evidence. If it isn't, we need to discuss what you intend to do.”
life.story.oath_collection.continue: Examine the oath and evidence of breach
life.story.oath_collection.withdraw: End the meeting with the matter unresolved
life.story.oath_collection.choice.eviden: Check whether the terms and exceptions apply
life.story.oath_collection.evidence: You examine the deadline, applicable conditions, and evidence. The collector waits until you finish. Compensation has a stated price; release requires the creditor's voluntary signature. If payment cannot be arranged, he can convey a release request, but cannot approve it himself.
life.story.oath_collection.choice.a: Pay one hundred wealth, seeking release if payment cannot be arranged
life.story.oath_collection.choice.b: Ask the creditor to sign a voluntary release
life.story.oath_collection.choice.c: Fight the collector and resist this collection attempt
life.story.oath_collection.decision: The collector writes down the compensation of one hundred wealth and offers payment or a request for release. You may refuse this collection attempt, but he warns you. “Driving me away only ends today's visit. The oath remains until the creditor signs a release or you produce proof of settlement.”
life.story.oath_collection.a: After checking the compensation, the collector records the settlement date beside the original oath and gives you the receipt to inspect. Once you confirm the amount, he puts away the documents and declares the collection closed.
life.story.oath_collection.a.later: The agreed settlement receipt is retained, and this oath produces no further collection claims.
life.story.oath_collection.b: The collector submits the release request and waits for the creditor's reply before reviewing the oath with you again. The waiver carries a clear signature. He hands you a copy. “The creditor has agreed to end it. Keep this proof.”
life.story.oath_collection.b.later: The creditor's release is filed with the original oath, recording the agreed termination date.
life.story.oath_collection.c: The collector obtains neither payment nor a release, and this attempt ends for now. Once the doorway is quiet again, the original oath remains on the table. Whether another collector comes depends on how the debt is handled.
life.story.oath_collection.c.later: The file records this collection attempt as suspended. The original oath remains unsettled.
life.story.oath_collection.withdrawn: You explain that you will make no new commitment today. The collector ends the meeting and records the matter as unresolved. The original oath remains in force, and the allegation still needs an answer.
life.story.spirit_mist.title: The Mist That Eats the Road
life.story.spirit_mist.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.spirit_mist.opening: You intended only to pass through the village, yet this is your third return to the same milestone. A familiar figure beckons from the mist, then dissolves into moths as you approach. A call from the abandoned well persists after the illusion vanishes. “Don't follow it! We're in the cellar!”
life.story.spirit_mist.continue: Follow the call to the trapped villagers
life.story.spirit_mist.withdraw: Stop advancing and retreat to recognizable ground
life.story.spirit_mist.choice.evidence: Mark recurring landmarks and distinguish the real paths
life.story.spirit_mist.evidence: Boards cover a cellar entrance beside the well. The people below hid there from the spore moths. Those who tried to find a way out returned to the same well. You mark your route and ask them to stay together while a figure in the mist beckons toward another lane.
life.story.spirit_mist.rush: Inspect the source of contamination in the well
life.story.spirit_mist.choice.a: Purify the well core, switching to evacuation if it fails
life.story.spirit_mist.choice.b: Evacuate the villagers, then destroy and seal the contaminated area
life.story.spirit_mist.choice.c: Look for an escape route for yourself
life.story.spirit_mist.decision: An old core is lodged below the well wall. Moths cluster around it, and mist pours from the same place. Purifying it may preserve the village. Otherwise, people must be evacuated before the contamination is burned and the roads sealed. The villagers ask whether you can lead them. You may also try to escape alone.
life.story.spirit_mist.a: The core stops producing mist, and the village road finally leads outside. Someone from the cellar tests it and returns without being trapped in a loop. Only then do the others help one another up. You explain the moths and their illusions to those staying to care for them.
life.story.spirit_mist.a.later: Once the road reopens, the villagers begin clearing the contamination around the well. The rescue roster lists only people actually found.
life.story.spirit_mist.b: Once the people are safe, fire seals off the contaminated village. Someone tries to return for belongings and is pulled back by a neighbor. You count those present and arrange shelter for the night. Surviving the escape still leaves them without their homes.
life.story.spirit_mist.b.later: Resettlement plans follow the evacuation roster. The ruined homes do not return when the mist clears.
life.story.spirit_mist.c: You reach the edge of the mist, still bearing the effects of exposure and injury. Once your breathing settles, you watch the road behind you. None of the people from the cellar emerge. You have found your way out; their call remains unanswered.
life.story.spirit_mist.c.later: The record confirms your escape. The trapped villagers' fate remains unresolved.
life.story.spirit_mist.withdrawn: You retreat to a stretch of road where you can still judge direction and leave a warning about what you witnessed. Voices remain in the mist. You do not follow them farther and cannot confirm how the people by the well will escape.
life.story.rival_return.title: The Rival at the Gate
life.story.rival_return.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.rival_return.opening: Your visitor stops outside without using the familiar greeting. He puts a token from your old dispute on the table and asks whether you remember what happened. “I'm not here to be told it's all in the past.” His hand rests on his sword. “Settle it with me, or face me.”
life.story.rival_return.withdraw: Decline to continue and end the meeting
life.story.rival_return.choice.evidence: Check the records for the central disagreement
life.story.rival_return.evidence: You compare what each of you remembers, separating supported facts from disputed claims. He remains unwilling to yield but will hear compensation terms. “Don't promise another opportunity someday. If you want to settle this, offer something definite today.”
life.story.rival_return.choice.a: Agree to spare the loser and duel
life.story.rival_return.choice.b: Offer one hundred wealth and negotiate reconciliation
life.story.rival_return.decision: He lays his sheathed sword on the table and waits. Mediation requires one hundred wealth and his agreement to the terms. A duel can be fought under a promise to spare the loser. Only an explicitly accepted lethal duel puts your lives at stake.
life.story.rival_return.a: The facts and compensation are finally agreed. He puts away the token and signs the terms he accepts. Before leaving, he says ordinary dealings may resume, though the old friendship has not returned. At least you can now finish a conversation without hostility.
life.story.rival_return.a.later: The mediation agreement records compensation and the accepted facts. Your relationship settles into neutrality.
life.story.rival_return.b: Once the result is clear, you stop as agreed. After catching his breath, your opponent acknowledges the defeat and sheathes his weapon. The past remains unsettled, but he leaves room for another conversation.
life.story.rival_return.b.later: The duel adds no death to the dispute. Sparing him leaves future mediation possible.
life.story.rival_return.c: Your rival falls and does not rise. The lethal duel is over. You put away your weapon, leaving only one side able to explain the old token. People connected to him will still hear the news and ask what happened.
life.story.rival_return.c.later: His death enters the relationship record. Those still living will bear what follows.
life.story.rival_return.withdrawn: The meeting ends without a settlement. No promise of reconciliation is exchanged. Each side leaves with its account and evidence, and the dispute remains open.
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.title: The Mountain Loses Its Breath
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.opening: Cracks from the mine have reached the village, and dull sounds come from the mountain. The watchman is counting evacuated workers at the entrance. When you arrive, he points to gaps in the list. “These people are still below. Three pillars are holding for now. We need a usable route first.”
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.continue: Inspect the cracks and supporting pillars
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.withdraw: Give the watchman your findings and withdraw
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.choice.e: Assess the damaged vein against the maintenance record
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.evidence: The watchman gives you the maintenance records and points out previously reported damage. The three pillars still carry the load, though stones keep falling around them. “We need to establish responsibility,” he says, “but we can't wait for that to rescue people. How long will this hold?”
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.choice.a: Stabilize all three pillars before the collapse
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.choice.b: Evacuate the workers and seal the unstable mine
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.choice.c: Find a route out for yourself
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.decision: Energy from the vein's heart forms a construct that advances toward the pillars with each tremor. The watchman identifies it as a product of the instability. Every delay widens the cracks. You can try to stabilize all three pillars, then evacuate and seal the mine if that fails. Escaping alone may be easier, but it will not save the mining district.
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.a: Once the pillars hold, the workers can leave their posts. The watchman counts them again and marks where continuing maintenance is needed. Shifts and expenses are discussed. Recovery now depends on carrying those arrangements through.
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.a.later: The maintenance assignments are signed after the rescue. All three pillars require regular inspection.
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.b: After the workers leave, the mine is sealed along the surveyed fracture, relieving the mountain's pressure. No new cracks appear by the village, but the entrance is unusable. The watchman closes the roster and asks how everyone will earn a living now.
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.b.later: The nearby village escapes the collapse, but new livelihoods must be arranged after the mine closes.
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.c: A louder collapse sounds behind you as you reach the mountain's edge. Later reports say the mining district is beyond repair and survivors are relocating. People who once passed through the entrance each day must find new homes and work.
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.c.later: The permanent damage and survivors' relocation are recorded together. Your escape did not halt the disaster.
life.story.spirit_vein_collapse.withdraw: You explain the condition of the pillars and cracks, then tell the watchman you will go no farther. He sends the information down the mine and urges the remaining workers out. The mountain is still shaking, and the response is unfinished.
life.story.friend_betrayal.title: The Friend with a Drawn Sword
life.story.friend_betrayal.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.friend_betrayal.opening: An old friend blocks the mountain path with a drawn sword and demands your belongings. The words sound rehearsed, as though he fears leaving one out. You notice fresh rope marks on his wrist. When you approach, he raises the blade while glancing past you toward the trees.
life.story.friend_betrayal.continue: Watch his injuries and the movement in the trees
life.story.friend_betrayal.withdraw: Withdraw without forcing him to continue the exchange
life.story.friend_betrayal.choice.eviden: Identify the captors' positions and weaknesses in their coercion
life.story.friend_betrayal.evidence: Following his glance, you see his companion Song Shi tied beside a tree with guards behind him. Your friend lowers his voice as he approaches. “They told me to delay you or they'll kill Song Shi. Don't look again. They're watching.” He steps back without daring to lower the sword.
life.story.friend_betrayal.choice.a: Cooperate with your friend to rescue Song Shi
life.story.friend_betrayal.choice.b: Attempt to restrain his weapon and separate, risking a fatal accident
life.story.friend_betrayal.decision: Your friend shifts slightly, showing how a staged exchange could bring you closer to the captors. Cooperation may save Song Shi. To leave separately, you must first control his blade. Someone in the trees orders him to attack. His shaking grip makes even an attempted restraint dangerous.
life.story.friend_betrayal.a: With Song Shi untied, your friend helps him stand before thanking you. He starts to explain, then pauses. “Let me tell you on the way. I owe you an account of this.” The rescue allows conversation to continue, but the sword raised against you will take time to put behind you.
life.story.friend_betrayal.a.later: Song Shi is rescued and the coercion explained. Some friendship returns, though trust still needs rebuilding.
life.story.friend_betrayal.b: You both put away your weapons, but make no agreement to travel together. Your friend watches you leave. The rescue has not been completed in this encounter, and the help once taken for granted between you can no longer be assumed.
life.story.friend_betrayal.b.later: The relationship returns to neutrality. Song Shi's captivity and the captors still require a separate response.
life.story.friend_betrayal.c: When the exchange ends, your friend is no longer breathing. Whether you intended retaliation or escape, the result cannot be undone. The coercion in the trees remains unresolved, and the two of you will never sit down to explain what happened.
life.story.friend_betrayal.c.later: Your friend's death ends the relationship. The abduction and responsibility for the confrontation remain in the subsequent record.
life.story.friend_betrayal.withdrawn: You step back and stop fighting. Your friend does not pursue, but cannot turn away from the watchers in the trees. Song Shi remains captive. Your withdrawal ends only the immediate confrontation.
life.story.pill_soul.title: The Second Soul in the Pill
life.story.pill_soul.objective: Protect the objective or overcome the opponent
life.story.pill_soul.opening: The Soul-Concealing Pill you took earlier has not fully dissolved. During practice tonight, a voice within its energy tells you to stop. Calling himself Yan Qiu, it warns that further refinement will entangle you both. You halt and ask where he is. “Inside the pill's seal,” he answers. “I can't get out either.”
life.story.pill_soul.continue: Examine the link between the medicine and the remnant soul
life.story.pill_soul.withdraw: Stop contact and seek another approach
life.story.pill_soul.choice.evidence: Isolate the medicine and distinguish your separate awareness
life.story.pill_soul.evidence: The seal protects Yan Qiu's remnant but also holds part of your awareness. When you move the medicine's energy, he feels the pull and asks you to identify the connections first. He describes his past through the seal while you compare his account with the pill's reactions.
life.story.pill_soul.rush: Discuss how to end the entanglement
life.story.pill_soul.choice.a: Preserve limited memories with his consent
life.story.pill_soul.choice.b: Clear the soul and medicine, forfeiting the pill's benefits
life.story.pill_soul.choice.c: Force absorption, accepting a lethal risk
life.story.pill_soul.decision: Yan Qiu can offer only limited memories, far from his full cultivation. He will negotiate what may be preserved, but does not consent to being absorbed. Clearing the medicine means losing its benefits; forcing the process may tear the linked awareness apart. Neither of you can guarantee that an attempt can be stopped midway.
life.story.pill_soul.a: You agree on each memory to be kept, stopping where Yan Qiu refuses consent. Only after the agreement is complete are the limited fragments preserved. Understanding them will take time; your channels and realm remain your own.
life.story.pill_soul.a.later: The preserved memories are clearly bounded. Their knowledge requires study and cannot be used as Yan Qiu's cultivation.
life.story.pill_soul.b: As the medicine clears, the voice stops pulling at your awareness. The pill's potential benefits are lost with it, leaving channels that need careful recovery. You arrange rest and put aside any thought of trying another pill.
life.story.pill_soul.b.later: Recovery follows purification. The forfeited benefits of the pill do not return.
life.story.pill_soul.c: Once the seal fails, the conflict between medicine and awareness can no longer be contained. This simulated life ends in the pill calamity, with the remaining evidence entered in a memorial account. Your character outside the simulation is unaffected.
life.story.pill_soul.c.later: The memorial account closes with the failed treatment of the remnant soul. This life does not continue.
life.story.pill_soul.withdrawn: You stop further refinement, note the connections identified so far, and cease responding to Yan Qiu for now. The alteration remains, but you can better explain it when seeking help.
life.story.dynasty_end.title: The Last Winter of the Dynasty
life.story.dynasty_end.opening:
As winter begins, village wells dry up one after another. People visit the relief station daily to ask when water will return. Qin Ruo asks you to review the reports, while Chu An brings a map of the well formations. Water and spiritual energy are being diverted toward the capital, leaving the outer fields unable to endure the winter.

“We need to know where to start dismantling it,” Qin Ruo says. “And we can't keep leaving these people to wait.”
life.story.dynasty_end.continue: Review the formations and relief routes
life.story.dynasty_end.withdraw: Leave the reports with Qin Ruo and Chu An and withdraw
life.story.dynasty_end.choice.evidence: Trace the anchors and determine a dismantling sequence
life.story.dynasty_end.evidence: You match dry wells with the outer anchors, confirming that the shortage is widespread. Chu An marks the roads still passable, while Qin Ruo sends food and medicine ahead. “Not everyone needs to fight the well guards. Opening one stretch of road can get another group out.”
life.story.dynasty_end.rush: Discuss entering the city or evacuating people
life.story.dynasty_end.choice.a: Defeat the well guards, stop the rite, and take over administration
life.story.dynasty_end.choice.b: Negotiate a council to dismantle the formations and manage relief
life.story.dynasty_end.choice.c: Prioritize civilian evacuation and seek to avoid the throne
life.story.dynasty_end.decision: Well guards protect the central rite. Interrupting it leaves the granaries and formations needing administration. Qin Ruo explains that governing would cost your side thirty wealth each year. Even an evacuation may require temporary control if the routes are blocked. A council offers another way to share dismantling, relief, and government.
life.story.dynasty_end.a: With the formations dismantled, resources can be redistributed. At the council's first meeting, Qin Ruo puts the relief ledger on the table and asks who is responsible for each delivery and when it will arrive. Chu An continues checking roads outside. This is where the capital's recovery begins.
life.story.dynasty_end.a.later: The council takes responsibility for relief and government. Dismantling is only the beginning; distribution requires continuing work.
life.story.dynasty_end.b: After the old ruler withdraws, your side takes control of the wells and granaries and cannot immediately leave their administration. The handover lists available wealth alongside annual governing costs of thirty wealth. Qin Ruo hands you both pages and waits for the next grain allocation.
life.story.dynasty_end.b.later: Control brings power and wealth, along with continuing costs. Failure to maintain them will worsen local unrest.
life.story.dynasty_end.c: Chu An finds somewhere to sit only after the last civilians are settled. You decline the throne and work with Qin Ruo to arrange shelter, food, and care for the sick. The dynasty's damage remains, but these people have somewhere to spend the night.
life.story.dynasty_end.c.later: The rescue record lists the civilians actually settled. The dynasty's subsequent course remains a separate, unfinished matter.
life.story.dynasty_end.withdrawn: You give Qin Ruo and Chu An your findings on the wells and roads, explaining that you will not manage the next steps. They accept the reports and continue assigning relief supplies. The city remains in crisis, and people outside are still waiting for water.

life.replacement.third_bell.title: The Third Bell
life.replacement.third_bell.S01.title: A Debt by the Stove
life.replacement.third_bell.S01.en_us.0: You are lodging at Reedbank's clinic when the healer Du Fen asks for help investigating the sluice. She cannot leave her patients, and her son Qiao has not returned from the gate. She has just pushed a bowl of rice towards you when the village bell rings. At the third stroke she pauses and turns towards the door.
life.replacement.third_bell.S01.en_us.1: Du: “We ring it once when we draw water in the morning and twice in the evening. There shouldn't be a third stroke.”
